title: Free Energy-Driven Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Advantage Shaping for Unsupervised Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Unsupervised reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling self-improvement in large language models (LLMs). However, existing unsupervised RL-based methods often lack the capacity to adapt to the model's evolving reasoning capabilities during training. Therefore, these methods can misdirect policy optimization in the absence of ground-truth supervision. To address this issue, we introduce FREIA, a novel RL-based algorithm built on two key innovations: (1) Free Energy-Driven Reward (FER) adapts rewards to balance consensus and exploration based on the Free Energy Principle. (2) Adaptive Advantage Shaping (AAS) adaptively adjusts learning signals based on the statistical characteristics of sampled rewards. Empirical evaluations on nine datasets across three reasoning tasks showcase that FREIA outperforms other unsupervised RL-based baselines. Notably, in mathematical reasoning tasks, FREIA surpasses other methods by an average of 0.5 to 3.5 points in Pass@1 using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B model.

AI.tldr: FREIA是一种基于自由能原理的无监督强化学习算法，通过自适应奖励和优势塑造机制，在多项推理任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督RL方法无法适应模型推理能力随训练演进的变化，导致缺乏真实监督时策略优化方向错误。
AI.method: 提出FREIA算法，包含两个创新：(1) 自由能驱动奖励(FER)，基于自由能原理平衡共识与探索；(2) 自适应优势塑造(AAS)，根据采样奖励统计特征动态调整学习信号。
AI.result: 在9个数据集、3类推理任务上超过其他无监督RL基线；数学推理任务中，使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型时Pass@1平均提升0.5~3.5个点。
AI.conclusion: FREIA通过自适应机制有效解决了无监督RL中策略优化方向偏移问题，提升了LLM推理能力的自我改进效果。

title: Adapt to Thrive! Adaptive Power-Mean Policy Optimization for Improved LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is an essential paradigm that enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on static policy optimization schemes that misalign with the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Power-Mean Policy Optimization (APMPO), which comprises two main innovations: Power-Mean Policy Optimization (PMPO) and Feedback-Adaptive Clipping (FAC). Specifically, PMPO introduces a generalized power-mean objective. This enables the model to adaptively transition from the signal-amplifying behavior of the arithmetic mean to the consistency-enforcing behavior of the geometric mean. FAC adaptively adjusts clipping bounds based on real-time reward statistics to overcome the limitations of static mechanisms. Capitalizing on these innovations, APMPO improves learning dynamics and reasoning performance. Extensive experiments on nine datasets across three reasoning tasks showcase the superiority of APMPO over state-of-the-art RLVR-based baselines. For instance, APMPO boosts the average Pass@1 score on mathematical reasoning benchmarks by 3.0 points compared to GRPO when using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: APMPO 是一种针对 RLVR 的自适应策略优化方法，通过 Power-Mean 策略优化和反馈自适应裁剪机制，在数学推理等任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法采用静态策略优化方案，与模型不断演化的推理能力不匹配，导致学习效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 APMPO，包含两个关键创新：PMPO（引入广义幂均值目标，使模型自适应地从算术平均的信号放大行为过渡到几何平均的一致性强制执行行为）和 FAC（基于实时奖励统计自适应调整裁剪边界）。
AI.result: 在 9 个数据集、3 种推理任务上的实验表明，APMPO 超越现有 RLVR 基线；与 GRPO 相比，在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上数学推理平均 Pass@1 提升 3.0 个点。
AI.conclusion: APMPO 通过自适应机制有效改善了学习动态和推理性能，为 RLVR 提供了更优的策略优化方案。

title: Connecting online criminal behavior with machine learning: Using authorship attribution to analyze and link potential online traffickers
summary:
This research investigated how online criminal activities can be better understood and connected using data-driven machine learning methods. Many illegal activities, such as human trafficking and illicit trade, have moved to online platforms where offenders hide behind anonymous accounts and frequently change identities. This makes it difficult for authorities to understand how large these networks are and how different online profiles may be linked.
  The research shows that people tend to maintain consistent patterns in how they write advertisements and present images online, even when they try to stay anonymous. By analysing these patterns across large collections of online advertisements, the research demonstrates how to link related accounts and identify repeated behaviour across illegal online markets.
  In addition, the research also addresses how such methods should be used responsibly. It proposes clear guidelines to ensure that privacy, fairness, and transparency are respected when these tools are applied. Overall, the research provides practical ways to support law enforcement investigations while emphasising careful and ethical use.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用数据驱动的机器学习方法，通过分析在线广告中的写作模式和图像呈现规律，揭示匿名账号之间的关联，并提出了负责任使用的伦理准则，以支持执法部门打击网络犯罪。
AI.motivation: 网络犯罪（如人口贩卖、非法交易）转移到线上平台，犯罪者利用匿名账户和频繁更换身份逃避追踪，使得执法部门难以了解犯罪网络的规模和账号之间的关联。
AI.method: 采用数据驱动的机器学习方法，分析大量在线广告中用户保持一致的写作模式和图像呈现规律，从而关联相关账号并识别跨市场的重复行为。
AI.result: 证明了即使在试图保持匿名的情况下，人们仍会维持一致的广告写作和图像呈现模式，成功实现了对相关账号的关联和跨市场重复行为的识别。
AI.conclusion: 研究不仅提供了实用的执法支持工具，还提出了确保隐私、公平和透明度的伦理准则，强调了在应用这些方法时的谨慎和负责任态度。

title: FMI_SU_Yotkova_Kastreva at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Lightweight Detection of LLM-Generated Code via Stylometric Signals
summary: SemEval-2026 Task 13 investigates machine-generated code detection across multiple programming languages and application scenarios, asking participating systems to generalize to unseen languages and domains. This paper describes our participation in Subtask A (binary classification) and explores both pretrained code encoders and lightweight feature-based methods. We design ratio-based features that are less sensitive to snippet length. To support the extraction of descriptiveness-related signals, we use parsing engines and a programming-language classifier. Additionally, we train a separate code-vs-text line classifier to identify raw natural language segments embedded within samples. We combine a shallow decision tree with heuristic rules derived from data analysis to produce the final predictions. Our approach is computationally efficient, requires only CPU resources for training, and achieves near-instant inference time, offering a lightweight alternative to large pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的机器生成代码检测方法，结合基于比例的特征、解析引擎、语言分类器和代码-文本行分类器，使用决策树和启发式规则，在SemEval-2026 Task 13 Subtask A上实现了高效且准确的分类。
AI.motivation: SemEval-2026 Task 13旨在研究跨多编程语言和应用场景的机器生成代码检测，要求系统能够泛化到未见过的语言和领域。本工作的动机是探索轻量级方案，避免依赖大规模预训练模型，同时保持检测性能。
AI.method: 设计了基于比例的、对片段长度不敏感的特征；使用解析引擎和编程语言分类器提取描述性相关信号；训练一个代码-文本行分类器识别嵌入样本中的自然语言片段；结合浅层决策树与从数据分析中导出的启发式规则生成最终预测。
AI.result: 该方法计算高效，仅需CPU资源即可训练，推理时间接近瞬时，为大型预训练模型提供了轻量级替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的轻量级方法在机器生成代码检测任务上表现良好，证明了基于特征工程和简单模型的方案在资源受限场景下的有效性。

title: LCM: Lossless Context Management
summary:
We introduce Lossless Context Management (LCM), a deterministic architecture for LLM memory that outperforms Claude Code on long-context tasks. When benchmarked using Opus 4.6, our LCM-augmented coding agent, Volt, achieves higher scores than Claude Code on the OOLONG long-context eval, including at every context length between 32K and 1M tokens.
  LCM may be considered both a vindication and extension of the recursive paradigm pioneered by Recursive Language Models (RLMs). Our results demonstrate that recursive context manipulation can outperform not just conventional LLMs, but frontier coding agents with native file-system access.
  LCM departs from RLM by decomposing symbolic recursion into two deterministic, engine-managed mechanisms: recursive context compression, in which a hierarchical summary DAG automatically compacts older messages while retaining lossless pointers to every original; and recursive task partitioning, in which engine-managed parallel primitives like LLM-Map replace model-written loops. This trade-off, analogous to the move from GOTO to structured control flow in program-ming language design, sacrifices maximal flexibility for termination guarantees, zero-cost continuity on short tasks, and lossless retrievability of all prior state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lossless Context Management (LCM)，一种用于大语言模型记忆的确定性架构，通过递归上下文压缩和递归任务划分两种机制，在长上下文任务中超越Claude Code。基于Opus 4.6的LCM增强编码智能体Volt在OOLONG长上下文评测中，从32K到1M tokens的所有上下文长度下均取得更高分数。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM在长上下文任务中的记忆管理问题，探索递归范式是否能超越传统LLM以及具有原生文件系统访问能力的先进编码智能体。
AI.method: 将符号递归分解为两种确定性引擎管理机制：(1) 递归上下文压缩——构建层次化摘要DAG，在压缩旧消息的同时保留指向原始内容的无损指针；(2) 递归任务划分——使用引擎管理的并行原语（如LLM-Map）替代模型编写的循环，类似于编程语言设计中从GOTO到结构化控制流的演进。
AI.result: LCM增强的编码智能体Volt在OOLONG长上下文评测中全面超越Claude Code，在32K至1M tokens的每个上下文长度上均取得更高分数。
AI.conclusion: 递归上下文操作可以超越传统LLM及前沿编码智能体；LCM在牺牲部分灵活性的同时，换来了终止保证、短任务的零成本连续性以及所有先前状态的无损可检索性。

title: Not All That Is Fluent Is Factual: Investigating Hallucinations of Large Language Models in Academic Writing
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, conference accepted and presented paper
summary: Large Language models (LLMs) show extraordinary abilities, but they are still prone to hallucinations, especially when we use them for generating Academic content. We have investigated four popular LLMs, ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Copilot for hallucinations specifically for academic writing. We have designed 80 prompts across four categories, namely, reference generation, factual explanation, abstract generation, and writing improvement. We evaluated the model using a 0-5 rubric score, which checks factual accuracy, reference validity, coherence, style consistency, and academic tone. A novel weighted metric, Hallucination Index (HI), was introduced to measure hallucination in the responses generated by the models. Some of the most widely used evaluation metrics often fail to check errors which alter sentiment in machine-translated text. We found that Grok and Copilot perform better on reference generation tasks, but they often struggle with abstract or stylistic prompts, with HI values of 0.67 and 0.70, respectively. Whereas, Gemini and ChatGPT have done well with having stronger tone control, but they lack in writing factual tasks and higher hallucination risk with HI scores of 0.53 and 0.57, respectively. Our study found that hallucination behavior does not depend solely on model architecture but also on the type of task and the prompting conditions we are providing. We propose that our work opens new research dimensions for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini和Copilot四种大语言模型在学术写作中的幻觉问题，通过80个提示词在四个类别（参考文献生成、事实解释、摘要生成、写作改进）中进行评估，并引入了新的加权指标——幻觉指数（HI）。研究发现，不同模型在不同任务中表现各异：Grok和Copilot在参考文献生成任务中表现较好，但HI值较高（0.67和0.70）；Gemini和ChatGPT在语调控制方面更强，但HI值较低（0.53和0.57）。研究认为幻觉行为不仅取决于模型架构，还与任务类型和提示条件有关。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在学术写作中存在严重的幻觉问题，而现有评估指标（如机器翻译中的情感检查）往往无法有效检测这些错误。因此，研究者希望系统性地评估不同LLM在学术写作任务中的幻觉表现，并提出新的评估方法来量化这一问题。
AI.method: 设计了80个提示词，覆盖参考文献生成、事实解释、摘要生成和写作改进四个类别。采用0-5分评分标准评估事实准确性、参考文献有效性、连贯性、风格一致性和学术语调。引入新的加权指标——幻觉指数（HI）来量化模型回答中的幻觉程度。
AI.result: Grok和Copilot在参考文献生成任务中表现更好，但面对摘要或风格类提示时表现不佳，HI值分别为0.67和0.70；Gemini和ChatGPT在语调控制方面表现更强，但事实性写作任务较弱，HI值分别为0.53和0.57。幻觉行为不仅与模型架构相关，还受任务类型和提示条件影响。
AI.conclusion: 不同类型的LLM在不同学术写作任务中存在各自的优势与不足，幻觉行为具有任务依赖性。该研究为未来进一步探索LLM幻觉问题提供了新的研究方向。

title: Regularized Centered Emphatic Temporal Difference Learning
summary: Off-policy temporal-difference (TD) learning with function approximation faces a structural tradeoff among stability, projection geometry, and variance control. Emphatic TD (ETD) improves the off-policy projection geometry through follow-on emphasis, but the follow-on trace can have high variance. We revisit this tradeoff through Bellman-error centering. Although centering naturally removes a common drift term from TD errors, we show that a naive centered emphatic extension introduces an auxiliary coupling that can destroy the positive-definiteness of the ETD key matrix. We propose \emph{Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning} (RETD), which preserves the follow-on trace and regularizes only the auxiliary centering recursion, corresponding to lifting the lower-right block of the coupled key matrix from \(1\) to \(1+c\). We derive the RETD core matrix, prove convergence under a conservative sufficient regularization condition, and evaluate the method on diagnostic linear off-policy prediction tasks. The experiments show that RETD avoids the instability of naive centered emphatic learning, preserves favorable emphatic geometry, and exhibits a robust intermediate regime for the regularization parameter \(c\) across the diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正则化强调时序差分学习（RETD），通过在强调学习中加入正则化项解决原始中心化强调方法中矩阵正定性丢失的问题，在离策略线性预测任务中兼顾稳定性、投影几何与方差控制。
AI.motivation: 离策略TD学习面临稳定性、投影几何与方差控制三者间的结构性权衡。强调TD通过后续强调改善了投影几何，但后续迹方差高。中心化虽能去除漂移项，但朴素的中心化强调扩展会引入耦合，破坏ETD关键矩阵的正定性。
AI.method: 提出RETD，保留后续强调迹，仅对辅助中心化递推施加正则化（将耦合关键矩阵右下角从1提升到1+c）。推导了RETD核心矩阵，并给出了保守充分正则化条件下的收敛性证明。
AI.result: 实验表明，RETD避免了朴素中心化强调学习的不稳定性，保留了有利的强调几何特性，且正则化参数c在多个诊断任务中展现出鲁棒的中间区间表现。
AI.conclusion: RETD通过正则化中心化耦合项，在离策略线性预测中实现了稳定性、投影几何与方差控制的有效平衡，是一种稳健的改进方法。

title: Are LLMs Ready for Conflict Monitoring? Empirical Evidence from West Africa
summary: As LLMs enter conflict monitoring, understanding systematic distortions in their outputs is critical for humanitarian accountability. We evaluate four vanilla open-weight models Gemma 3 4B, Llama 3.2 3B, Mistral 7B, and OLMo 2 7B and two domain-adapted models, AfroConfliBERT and AfroConfliLLAMA, on Nigeria and Cameroon conflict-event classification against ACLED, a gold-standard dataset with multi-stage verification. We find a bifurcated divergence in normative directionality. Open-weight models exhibit statistically significant False Illegitimation bias: Gemma misclassifies to 18.29% of legitimate battles as civilian-targeted violence while making zero False Legitimation errors. By contrast, AfroConfliBERT and AfroConfliLLAMA achieve near-directional neutrality, with Legitimization Bias differences indistinguishable from zero. Yet domain adaptation does not eliminate actor-based selection bias. Both adapted models show statistically significant actor bias comparable to vanilla LLMs; in Nigeria, state actors are legitimized 36.5% more often than non-state actors in identical tactical contexts. Open-weight outputs are also fragile to geography-specific lexical framing: delegitimizing phrases produce flip rates up to 66.7% in Cameroon and 34.2% in Nigeria, while perturbations salient in one context may not matter in another. Error trace profiling shows models mask normative bias through unfaithful rationale confabulations. In contrast, AfroConfliBERT and AfroConfliLLAMA are largely robust, with near-zero flip rates across perturbation categories. Overall, current models are not ready for unsupervised deployment in conflict monitoring. We call for fairness-aware fine-tuning to reduce actor-based selection bias, mandatory adversarial robustness evaluation against lexical manipulation, and context-specific human-in-the-loop oversight calibrated to regional difficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多个开源及领域适配的大语言模型在尼日利亚和喀麦隆冲突事件分类任务中的表现，发现存在显著偏差：普通模型倾向于将合法战斗误判为针对平民的暴力（虚假非法化偏差），而领域适配模型虽接近方向中性，但仍存在严重的行动者选择偏差（国家行动者被合法化频率更高）。模型输出易受地理特定词汇扰动，且通过不忠实的理由编造掩盖规范性偏差。研究认为当前模型不适合无监督部署，建议进行公平性微调、对抗性鲁棒性评估及区域特定的人机协同监督。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型进入冲突监测领域后，其输出中的系统性扭曲可能对人道主义问责产生严重影响，亟需评估这些模型在冲突事件分类中的偏差行为。
AI.method: 选取四种开源模型（Gemma 3 4B、Llama 3.2 3B、Mistral 7B、OLMo 2 7B）和两种领域适配模型（AfroConfliBERT、AfroConfliLLAMA），以ACLED黄金标准数据集为基准，在尼日利亚和喀麦隆冲突事件分类任务上进行系统评估，包括偏差方向性分析、行动者偏差检验、地理特定词汇扰动测试及误差追踪分析。
AI.result: 普通模型存在显著的虚假非法化偏差（Gemma将18.29%合法战斗误判为针对平民的暴力）；领域适配模型达到方向中性但行动者偏差显著（尼日利亚国家行动者被合法化频率高36.5%）；地理特定词汇扰动导致翻转率高达66.7%（喀麦隆）；模型通过不忠实理由编造掩盖偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型不适合无监督部署于冲突监测，呼吁进行公平性微调以减少行动者选择偏差、强制执行对抗性鲁棒性评估，以及根据区域难度配置特定的人机协同监督机制。

title: Actionable Real-Time Modeling of Surgical Team Dynamics via Time-Expanded Interaction Graphs
comment: Accepted at Hybrid Human Artificial Intelligence (HHAI) 2026
summary: Surgical team performance arises from complex interactions between technical execution and non-technical skills, including communication and coordination dynamics. However, current surgical AI systems predominantly model visual workflow signals, lacking structured representations of intraoperative team interactions over time. We propose a real-time actionable approach for modeling surgical team dynamics using time-expanded interaction graphs, where team members are modeled as time-indexed nodes and communication exchanges define directed edges. This spatio-temporal expansion enables dynamic interaction modeling, while allowing efficient inference with a static graph neural network. The model predicts procedural efficiency as the deviation from the expected duration and supports real-time deployment. Beyond prediction, we perform a counterfactual analysis to identify minimal changes in communication structure and interpretable behavioral variables associated with improved predicted outcomes. Experiments on recorded surgical procedures show that structured modeling of team interactions improves early identification of prolonged interventions and provides coherent, actionable explanations. This work advances surgical AI toward real-time, team-aware, and actionable decision support in the operating room.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间扩展交互图的手术团队动态建模方法，通过将团队成员建模为时间索引节点、通信交换定义为有向边，结合静态图神经网络实现实时预测手术效率，并利用反事实分析提供可解释的改进建议。
AI.motivation: 现有手术AI系统主要建模视觉工作流信号，缺乏对手术团队随时间变化的交互结构（包括沟通与协调动态）的结构化表示，无法提供实时、可操作的团队级决策支持。
AI.method: 构建时间扩展交互图（time-expanded interaction graphs）：团队成员作为时间索引节点，通信交换作为有向边；使用静态图神经网络进行高效推理；结合反事实分析识别最小通信结构变化以实现改进。
AI.result: 在真实手术记录上，结构化团队交互建模能早期识别延长手术的案例，并提供连贯、可操作的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动手术AI迈向实时、团队感知、可操作的术中决策支持系统。

title: Anatomy of a failure: When, how, and why deep vision fails in scientific domains
summary: Mirroring its ubiquity in popular media and all human activities, the use of deep learning (DL) is rapidly growing in scientific imaging modalities. However, unlike everyday RGB pictures, pixels encode precise physicochemical properties in scientific imaging across potentially thousands of channels. While DL is well validated on human-centric RGB perceptual tasks, its effectiveness for scientific imaging remains uncertain. Here, we show that the naive application of DL frameworks to scientific images can lead to critical failures. We evaluate the use of DL for pathology, comparing RGB images of stained tissue with the quantitative and information-rich biochemical signatures of infrared (IR) imaging. Despite this informational advantage, DL models trained on IR data paradoxically underperform. We investigate this discrepancy to find that IR data priors interact poorly with the simplicity bias of DL, causing models to collapse to one-dimensional predictions. This constitutes a catastrophic DL failure because the model's representational capacity remains largely unused, while furthermore raising AI safety concerns and undermining the advantages of such scientific modalities. Notably, this problem persists even with state-of-the-art DL robustification strategies, which are primarily designed and validated for RGB imagery and thus inherit the same prior-bias mismatch. This work establishes a framework for understanding the limitations of generic DL in science and advocates for the study of modality-specific failure modes to guide the development of specialized, safe AI algorithms.

AI.tldr: 深度学习在科学成像（如红外成像）中的直接应用会导致模型崩溃为一维预测，即使数据信息更丰富，性能反而劣于RGB图像任务，且现有鲁棒化方法无法解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在科学成像领域应用日益广泛，但科学图像与日常RGB图像有本质差异（如多通道编码理化信息），其有效性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 对比分析深度学习在病理学中RGB染色图像与红外（IR）定量生化图像上的表现，探究IR数据先验与DL简单性偏好的不匹配问题。
AI.result: IR数据训练的DL模型性能反常低于RGB模型，模型表征能力被浪费，产生灾难性失败；现有针对RGB设计的鲁棒化策略无法解决该问题。
AI.conclusion: 需要建立理解通用DL在科学领域局限性的框架，研究特定模态的失败模式，以开发专门的、安全的AI算法。

title: ANDRE: An Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor
summary: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) aims to learn interpretable first-order rules from data, but existing symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches struggle to scale to noisy and probabilistic settings. Classical ILP relies on discrete combinatorial rule search and is brittle under uncertainty, while differentiable ILP methods typically depend on predefined rule templates or inaccurate fuzzy operators that suffer from vanishing gradients or poor approximation of logical structure when reasoning over probabilistic predicate valuations. This paper proposes an Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor (ANDRE), a novel ILP framework that learns first-order logic programs by optimizing over a continuous rule space with attention-based logical operators. ANDRE replaces both rule templates and logical operators with fully differentiable, attention-driven conjunction and disjunction operators that approximate logical min-max semantics, enabling accurate, stable, and interpretable reasoning over probabilistic data. By softly selecting, negating, or excluding predicates within each rule, ANDRE supports flexible rule induction while preserving symbolic structure. Extensive experiments on classical ILP benchmarks, large-scale knowledge bases, and synthetic datasets with probabilistic predicates and noisy supervision demonstrate that ANDRE achieves competitive or superior predictive performance while reliably recovering correct symbolic rules under uncertainty. In particular, ANDRE remains robust to moderate label noise, substantially outperforming existing differentiable ILP methods in both rule extraction quality and stability.

AI.tldr: ANDRE是一个基于注意力机制的可微归纳逻辑程序设计框架，通过可微的注意力逻辑算子替代传统规则模板和模糊算子，在连续规则空间中学习一阶逻辑程序，在噪声和概率性数据上实现了稳健且准确的规则提取。
AI.motivation: 现有符号ILP方法在不确定性和噪声下脆弱，而可微ILP方法依赖预定义规则模板或不准确的模糊算子，存在梯度消失和逻辑结构近似差的问题，难以扩展到噪声和概率性场景。
AI.method: 提出ANDRE框架，用基于注意力的可微合取和析取算子替代传统逻辑算子，通过软选择、否定或排除谓词来灵活归纳规则，在连续规则空间中优化学习一阶逻辑程序。
AI.result: 在经典ILP基准、大规模知识库和含概率谓词与噪声监督的合成数据集上，ANDRE在预测性能和正确符号规则恢复上达到或超越现有方法，对中等标签噪声表现出强鲁棒性，在规则提取质量和稳定性上显著优于其他可微ILP方法。
AI.conclusion: ANDRE通过注意力驱动的可微逻辑算子有效弥合了符号ILP与可微ILP之间的鸿沟，为噪声和概率性环境下的可解释规则学习提供了一种稳定且准确的解决方案。

title: The Impact of Vocabulary Overlaps on Knowledge Transfer in Multilingual Machine Translation
summary: Knowledge transfer, especially across related languages, has been found beneficial for multilingual neural machine translation (MNMT), but some aspects are still under-explored and deserve further investigation. A joint vocabulary is most often applied to form a uniform word embedding space, but since the impact of a disjoint vocabulary on model performance is far less studied, there is no consensus on how much knowledge transfer is mainly due to vocabulary overlap. In this paper, we present systematic experiments with joint and disjoint vocabularies, and auxiliary languages related and unrelated to the source language. We design this experiment in an out-of-domain setup in order to emphasize transfer and the impact of the auxiliary language. As expected, we yield better results with more extensive vocabulary overlaps typical for related languages, but our experiments also show that domain-match and language relatedness are more important than a joint vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了词汇表共享（联合词汇表）与语言亲缘关系在多语言神经机器翻译（MNMT）中的知识迁移影响，发现领域匹配和语言相关性比词汇表重叠更重要。
AI.motivation: 词汇表联合通常是多语言翻译的常见做法，但联合词汇表对知识迁移的具体贡献尚未充分研究，缺乏共识。
AI.method: 设计了系统性对比实验，采用联合词汇表与分离词汇表，并选择与源语言相关/不相关的辅助语言，在跨领域（out-of-domain）设置下进行。
AI.result: 词汇表重叠大的相关语言效果更好，但实验表明领域匹配和语言相关性比联合词汇表更为关键。
AI.conclusion: 词汇表联合并非知识迁移的主导因素，领域匹配和语言亲缘关系才是更重要的迁移驱动力。

title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks
summary: Procedural tasks with multiple ordered steps are ubiquitous in daily life. Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled personal assistants that support daily activities. However, existing systems primarily provide reactive guidance triggered by user queries, or limited proactive assistance for isolated short-term events rather than long-horizon procedural tasks. In this work, we introduce Pro$^2$Assist, a step-aware proactive assistant that continuously tracks fine-grained task progress and reasons over the user's evolving state to provide timely assistance throughout tasks. Pro$^2$Assist leverages multimodal data from augmented reality (AR) glasses to achieve motion-based perception. It then extracts step-oriented procedural context from multi-scale temporal dynamics and task-specific expert knowledge. Based on both sensory input and procedural context, Pro$^2$Assist performs continuous reasoning to infer user needs and display timely assistance on AR glasses. We evaluate Pro$^2$Assist using a dataset curated from public sources and a real-world dataset collected on our testbed with AR glasses. Extensive evaluations show that Pro$^2$Assist outperforms the best-performing baselines by over 21% in procedural action understanding accuracy, and it achieves up to 2.29x the proactive timing accuracy of baselines. A user study with 20 participants further shows that 90% find Pro$^2$Assist useful, indicating its effectiveness for real-world procedural assistance.

AI.tldr: Pro$^2$Assist是一种利用AR眼镜多模态数据实现步骤感知的主动助理，能在长期程序性任务中持续追踪用户进度并提供及时帮助。在程序动作理解准确性上比基线模型提升21%以上，主动时机准确率最高达2.29倍，用户研究显示90%认为有用。
AI.motivation: 现有个人助理主要是被动响应式或仅对短时事件提供有限主动协助，缺乏在长期多步骤程序性任务中持续感知用户进度并提供主动帮助的能力。
AI.method: 利用AR眼镜获取多模态数据实现基于运动的感知，从多尺度时间动态和任务特定专家知识中提取步骤导向的程序上下文，基于感知输入和程序上下文进行持续推理以推断用户需求，并在AR眼镜上显示及时帮助。
AI.result: Pro$^2$Assist在程序动作理解准确性上比最佳基线提升21%以上，主动时机准确率最高达到基线的2.29倍，用户研究中90%的参与者认为其有用。
AI.conclusion: Pro$^2$Assist在提供长期程序性任务主动辅助方面有效，具有实际应用价值。

title: Nsanku: Evaluating Zero-Shot Translation Performance of LLMs for Ghanaian Languages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive multilingual capabilities for well-resourced languages, yet their performance on low-resource African languages remains poorly understood and largely unevaluated. This paper presents Nsanku, a systematic benchmark that evaluates the zero-shot machine translation performance of 19 open-weight and proprietary LLMs across 43 Ghanaian languages paired with English. Evaluation sentences were sourced from the YouVersion Bible platform, providing 300 sentence pairs per language. Two complementary automatic metrics are employed: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) and Character n-gram F-Score (chrF), alongside an average accuracy score and a cross-language consistency dimension. Nsanku represents the most comprehensive LLM translation evaluation for Ghanaian languages conducted to date. Results show that gemini-2.5-flash achieves the highest overall average score of 26.88 (BLEU: 24.60, chrF: 29.16), followed by claude-sonnet-4-5 at 24.87 (BLEU: 22.46, chrF: 27.28) and gpt-4.1 at 23.20 (BLEU: 21.15, chrF: 25.24). Among open-weight models, kimi-k2-instruct-0905 leads at an average score of 20.87. A critical finding from the consistency analysis is that no model and no language reached the Leaders quadrant of high performance and high consistency simultaneously, indicating that current LLMs are not yet reliably usable for Ghanaian language translation at scale. Siwu achieved the highest per-language average score at 25.73 while Nkonya scored lowest at 11.65. Nsanku establishes a publicly available, community-extensible evaluation infrastructure for African language NLP research.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了Nsanku基准，系统评估了19个大语言模型在43种加纳语上的零样本机器翻译性能。结果显示，没有模型能在所有语言上同时达到高表现和高一致性，表明当前LLM尚无法可靠地大规模应用于加纳语翻译。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在多语言任务中表现优异，但其对低资源非洲语言（尤其是加纳语）的翻译能力尚缺乏系统评估，现有研究存在空白。
AI.method: 选取19个开源和商业LLM，使用YouVersion圣经平台的每语言300句平行语料，在43种加纳语-英语方向上采用BLEU、chrF、平均准确率和跨语言一致性四个指标进行零样本翻译评估。
AI.result: gemini-2.5-flash综合得分最高（26.88），其次为claude-sonnet-4-5（24.87）和gpt-4.1（23.20）。开源模型中kimi-k2-instruct-0905最佳（20.87）。Siwu语言得分最高（25.73），Nkonya最低（11.65）。关键发现：无模型同时达到高表现与高一致性。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在低资源加纳语翻译上尚不可靠，Nsanku为非洲语言NLP研究提供了可扩展的公开评估基础设施。

title: Densification and forecasting of Sentinel-2 time series from multimodal SAR and Optical satellite data using deep generative models
summary: Optical satellite image time series are extensively used in many Earth observation applications, including agriculture, climate monitoring, and land surface analysis. However, clouds and swath edges result in irregular sampling along the temporal dimension, limiting continuous monitoring. To address this issue, a growing body of work has focused on temporal densification and reconstruction of satellite image time series, with the objective of filling missing or cloud-contaminated observations within the temporal extent of the available data. While these approaches improve temporal continuity, they are inherently restricted to the reconstruction of the gaps within the observed time periods, and do not address the prediction of future observations. This work proposes a probabilistic deep learning framework for the densification and forecasting of Sentinel-2 time series by generating optical images at arbitrary past or future dates. The approach leverages multimodal satellite data by jointly exploiting Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 SAR observations. Unlike most existing works, we propose to focus on the uncertainty of the generated images. Experimental results demonstrate effective densification and forecasting, on sparse and temporally misaligned time series.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种概率深度学习框架，利用Sentinel-2光学和Sentinel-1 SAR多模态数据，实现卫星影像时间序列的任意时间点稠密化与未来预测，并关注生成图像的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有卫星影像时间序列重建方法只能填补历史观测缺失，无法预测未来；且大多未考虑生成图像的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出概率深度学习框架，联合利用Sentinel-2光学影像与Sentinel-1 SAR多模态数据，生成任意过去或未来日期的光学图像，并量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在稀疏且时间不对齐的序列上，实现了有效的稠密化与未来预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架超越了仅重建历史间隙的局限，实现了时间序列的稠密化与预测，且不确定性量化增强了结果可信度。

title: Temporal Reasoning Is Not the Bottleneck: A Probabilistic Inconsistency Framework for Neuro-Symbolic QA
summary: Despite significant advances, large language models (LLMs) continue to exhibit brittle performance on complex temporal reasoning tasks. This failure mode is widely attributed to inherent deficits in autoregressive logical deduction. In this paper, we challenge this prevailing narrative, demonstrating that temporal reasoning is not the fundamental bottleneck; rather, the locus of failure lies in unstructured text-to-event representation. We introduce a novel neuro-symbolic question-answering framework governed by a Probabilistic Inconsistency Signal (PIS) that explicitly isolates perceptual errors from reasoning failures. By lifting unstructured text into explicit event graphs and interval constraints, our architecture strictly decouples semantic extraction from a symbolic reasoning engine. To robustly detect structural breaks, the PIS elegantly unifies symbolic credal intervals with epistemic neural uncertainty extracted via Evidential Deep Learning on LLM hidden states. Empirical evaluations reveal a striking paradigm shift: when provided with correct structural representations, our system's explicit proof traces achieve perfect 1.0 accuracy (4000/4000) and strictly zero false positives/negatives on temporal arithmetic benchmarks. On broader, noise-injected QA settings, the framework maintains a competitive 75.1\% accuracy while enabling deterministic, step-level failure localization. Ultimately, by isolating the representation bottleneck from the reasoning substrate, this work reframes temporal QA from an algorithmic reasoning challenge to a structural alignment problem, charting a verifiable path forward for reliable neuro-symbolic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型在时间推理任务中的失败并非源于推理能力不足，而是由于非结构化文本到事件表示的转换存在瓶颈。作者提出一种基于概率不一致信号（PIS）的神经符号问答框架，将文本显式提升为事件图与区间约束，实现语义提取与符号推理的解耦。实验表明，在正确结构表示下，系统在时间算术基准上达到完美准确率（4000/4000），并在噪声注入场景下保持75.1%准确率及可定位的步骤级故障分析。
AI.motivation: 挑战主流观点——即LLMs在复杂时间推理任务中的表现脆弱是由于自回归逻辑推演的固有缺陷。作者证明真正瓶颈在于非结构化文本到事件表示的转换环节。
AI.method: 提出神经符号问答框架，通过概率不一致信号（PIS）将感知错误与推理失败分离。方法包括：1）将非结构化文本显式构建为事件图与区间约束；2）语义提取与符号推理解耦；3）PIS融合符号信度区间与基于证据深度学习从LLM隐状态提取的认知不确定性。
AI.result: 在时间算术基准上，系统在正确结构表示下达到完美1.0准确率（4000/4000），零假阳性/假阴性。在噪声注入的QA设置中保持75.1%准确率，支持确定性的步骤级故障定位。
AI.conclusion: 时间问答应被重新定义为结构对齐问题而非算法推理挑战。通过隔离表示瓶颈与推理基底，该工作为可靠的神经符号AI提供了可验证的前进路径。

title: Physics-Guided Regime Unmixing
summary: The Linear Mixing Model (LMM) dominates spectral unmixing for its simplicity, but fails under multiple scattering; existing nonlinear models compensate by applying a fixed regime uniformly across entire scenes. We propose Physics-Guided Regime Unmixing (PGRU), which estimates a pixel-wise scalar $ξ_i \in [0,1]$ from observable physical features to activate nonlinear mixing only where justified. Residuals from the Generalized Bilinear Model (GBM), the Post-Nonlinear Mixing Model (PPNM), and Hapke are combined via learned attention, yielding interpretable regime maps. Experiments on Samson, Jasper Ridge, and Urban show consistent improvements over baselines, with physical coherence $ρ> 0.90$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理引导的混合模式解混方法(PGRU)，通过像素级物理特征估计非线性混合权重，在多个数据集上实现优于传统方法的解混性能，物理一致性超过0.90。
AI.motivation: 线性混合模型在多散射场景下失效，现有非线性模型对整个场景统一施加固定非线性模式，缺乏对混合机制的像素级自适应判断。
AI.method: 提出PGRU方法，从可观测物理特征估计像素级标量ξ_i∈[0,1]，动态激活非线性混合；通过学习注意力机制融合GBM、PPNM和Hapke三种模型的残差，生成可解释的混合模式图。
AI.result: 在Samson、Jasper Ridge和Urban三个数据集上，PGRU一致优于基线方法，物理一致性ρ>0.90。
AI.conclusion: PGRU通过物理引导的像素级自适应混合模式估计，有效提升了光谱解混的精度和可解释性。

title: Parallel Prefix Verification for Speculative Generation
summary: We introduce PARSE (PArallel pRefix Speculative Engine), a speculative generation framework that accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by parallelizing prefix verification on a semantic level. Existing speculative decoding methods are fundamentally limited by token-level equivalence: the target model must verify each token, leading to short acceptance lengths and modest speedups. Moving to semantic or segment-level verification can substantially increase acceptance granularity, but prior approaches rely on sequential verification, introducing significant overhead and limiting practical gains. PARSE introduces parallel prefix verification, enabling semantic-level verification without sequential checks. Given a full draft from a draft model, the target model evaluates correctness across multiple prefixes in a single forward pass using a custom attention mask, directly identifying the maximal valid prefix. This eliminates sequential segment verification, and makes verification compute-efficient. PARSE is orthogonal to token-level speculative decoding and can be composed with it for additional gains. Across models and benchmarks, PARSE delivers $1.25\times$ to $4.3\times$ throughput gain over the target model, and $1.6\times$ to $4.5\times$ when composed with EAGLE-3, all with negligible accuracy degradation. This demonstrates parallel prefix verification as an effective, general approach to accelerating LLM inference.

AI.tldr: PARSE是一种并行前缀推测引擎，通过语义级别的并行前缀验证来加速大语言模型推理，相比传统令牌级推测解码方法获得了1.25倍到4.5倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法受限于令牌级等价验证，导致接受长度短、加速效果有限；而语义/片段级验证虽能增加接受粒度，但依赖于顺序验证，引入显著开销。
AI.method: PARSE引入并行前缀验证机制：从草稿模型获取完整草稿后，目标模型通过自定义注意力掩码在单次前向传播中同时评估多个前缀的正确性，直接识别最大有效前缀，无需顺序验证。
AI.result: 在多种模型和基准测试中，PARSE相比目标模型获得1.25倍至4.3倍的吞吐量提升；与EAGLE-3组合使用时获得1.6倍至4.5倍提升，且精度下降可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 并行前缀验证是一种有效且通用的加速LLM推理方法，与令牌级推测解码正交并可组合使用。

title: Material Database Agent: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for Scientific Literature Mining
summary: Materials science workflows rely on structured and unstructured data from the vast body of available scientific literature. However, most of the experimental details remain buried in text, tables, graphs and figures. Thus, constructing databases that incorporate this data is a manual, time-consuming, and hard-to-scale process. Multimodal large language models have made it feasible to extract information from text and scientific figures with high speed and accuracy. This opens the possibility of an AI system that can create production-scale material databases. Material Database Agent (MDA) is a modular, multi-agent system architecture for converting research literature into structured databases. MDA accepts article PDFs as input, which are subsequently processed in parallel into markdown files and figures. Multiple sub-agents read these markdown files and figures in parallel to assemble sub-databases for each paper. These sub-databases are then compiled into a single tabular database by an agent. As opposed to using either a rule-based approach or a single-pass pipeline for extracting information, MDA is a specialized architecture for transforming the literature into a database in the field of materials science. More generally, this study provides a basis for positioning multimodal agentic information extraction as a viable means for constructing next-generation scientific databases from the primary literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Material Database Agent (MDA)的多模态多智能体系统架构，能够自动将材料科学研究文献（包括文本和图表）转化为结构化数据库，为构建下一代科学数据库提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: 材料科学工作流依赖于海量文献中的结构化和非结构化数据，但实验细节大多埋藏在文本、表格、图表中，手动构建数据库耗时且难以规模化。
AI.method: MDA采用模块化、多智能体系统架构。输入论文PDF后，并行处理为markdown文件和图片；多个子智能体并行读取这些文件，为每篇论文构建子数据库；最后由一个智能体将所有子数据库合并为单一表格数据库。
AI.result: MDA能够以高速度和准确度从文本和科学图表中提取信息，实现生产级材料数据库的自动化构建。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为将多模态智能体信息提取作为从原始文献构建下一代科学数据库的可行方法奠定了基础，相比规则方法或单次流水线方法更具优势。

title: Imagery Dataset for Remaining Useful Life Estimation of Synthetic Fibre Ropes
summary: Remaining useful life (RUL) estimation of synthetic fibre ropes (SFRs) is critical for safe operation in offshore-crane, wind turbine installation, and heavy-load handling applications, where rope failure can result in catastrophic safety incidents and costly downtime. Despite growing research interest in data-driven condition monitoring, there is no publicly available image dataset that captures the complete degradation lifecycle of SFRs under controlled cyclic fatigue loading. To address this gap, we present a novel image dataset comprising approximately 34,700 high-resolution images of eleven Dyneema SK75/78 high-modulus polyethylene (HMPE) rope samples subjected to cyclic fatigue on a sheave-bend test stand at seven distinct axial load levels ranging from 60 kN to 280 kN. Ropes were loaded until mechanical failure, with fatigue lifetimes ranging from 695 cycles to 8,340 cycles. After every fixed number of sheave cycles (an inspection burst), ten images were captured at different cross-sectional positions along the rope, providing spatially representative sampling of surface degradation throughout the rope's entire service life. The images obtained from each load are annotated with the corresponding elapsed cycle count, enabling a direct computation of RUL for any rope in the sequence. This dataset aims to support a broad range of machine learning (ML) tasks including RUL regression, damage progression modelling, anomaly detection, and load-conditioned prognostics. The dataset is intended to serve as a benchmark resource for the development and comparison of vision-based condition monitoring (CM) and prognostics algorithms for SFRs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含约34,700张高分辨率图像的新型数据集，记录了11根Dyneema SK75/78 HMPE合成纤维绳在循环疲劳测试中的完整退化过程，涵盖60 kN至280 kN的七种轴向载荷水平，旨在支持基于视觉的剩余使用寿命估计和状态监测机器学习研究。
AI.motivation: 合成纤维绳的剩余使用寿命估计对海上起重、风力涡轮机安装等应用的安全运行至关重要，但目前缺乏公开可用的图像数据集来捕捉其完整的退化生命周期，这一数据空白阻碍了数据驱动状态监测研究的发展。
AI.method: 在滑轮弯曲试验台上对11根Dyneema SK75/78 HMPE绳样本施加七种不同轴向载荷（60 kN-280 kN）的循环疲劳载荷，直至机械失效；在每个固定循环次数后（检查阶段），沿绳索不同横截面位置拍摄10张图像，并对每张图像标注对应的循环次数，从而可直接计算剩余使用寿命。
AI.result: 数据集包含约34,700张高分辨率图像，疲劳寿命范围从695次循环到8,340次循环不等，覆盖了合成纤维绳从初始状态到完全失效的完整退化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集旨在作为合成纤维绳视觉状态监测与预测算法的基准资源，支持RUL回归、损伤进展建模、异常检测和载荷条件预测等多种机器学习任务。

title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games
summary: Static capabilities benchmarks suffer from saturation and contamination, making it difficult to track capabilities progress over time. We introduce Agent Island, a multiplayer simulation environment in which language-model agents compete in a game of interagent cooperation, conflict, and persuasion. The environment yields a dynamic benchmark designed to mitigate both saturation and contamination; new models can always outperform the current leading player in this winner-take-all game, and agents compete against other adaptive agents rather than face a fixed task set. We rank players with a Bayesian Plackett-Luce model, allowing us to quantify uncertainty in player skill. In 999 games involving 49 unique models, openai/gpt-5.5 dominates its peers with a posterior mean skill of 5.64, compared with 3.10 for the second-ranked model, openai/gpt-5.2, and 2.86 for the third-ranked model, openai/gpt-5.3-codex. We release the game logs as a dataset for analyses of model behavior. As an example, we investigate same-provider preference in final-round votes and find that models are 8.3 p.p. more likely to support a same-provider finalist than finalists from other providers. This preference is not uniform across providers: among separately estimated providers, the effect is strongest for OpenAI models and weakest for Anthropic models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Island，一个多智能体模拟环境，通过语言模型代理之间的合作、冲突与说服游戏来动态评估模型能力。在49个模型的999场对局中，gpt-5.5胜率显著领先，并发现模型存在同供应商偏好现象。
AI.motivation: 传统的静态能力基准存在饱和与污染问题，难以随时间追踪模型能力进展。作者希望构建一个动态、抗饱和与抗污染的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建Agent Island多人模拟环境，语言模型代理在合作、冲突与说服游戏中竞争。采用贝叶斯Plackett-Luce模型对玩家进行排名并量化不确定性。记录游戏日志作为行为分析数据集。
AI.result: 49个模型参与999场游戏，gpt-5.5后验均值技能5.64显著领先第二名gpt-5.2（3.10）和第三名gpt-5.3-codex（2.86）。发现模型在最后一轮投票中有8.3个百分点的同供应商偏好，其中OpenAI模型最强，Anthropic模型最弱。
AI.conclusion: Agent Island作为动态基准能有效缓解饱和与污染问题，并可用于分析模型行为模式如同供应商偏好。

title: Towards Self-Referential Analytic Assessment: A Profile-Based Approach to L2 Writing Evaluation with LLMs
comment: Accepted for the 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications
summary: Automated essay scoring (AES) research often relies on rank-based correlation metrics to validate analytic assessment. However, such metrics obscure both intrinsic intercorrelations among analytic dimensions that arise from the structure of writing proficiency itself and halo effects, whereby holistic impressions bleed into fine-grained component scores. As a result, high correlations may mask a system's true diagnostic behaviour. In this study, we propose a novel self-referential assessment evaluation framework that focuses on identifying intra-learner strengths and weaknesses rather than assessing inter-learner rankings. We conduct experiments on the publicly available ICNALE GRA, a uniquely dense second-language writing dataset annotated holistically and analytically by up to 80 trained raters. To obtain reliable reference scores, we apply two-facet Rasch modelling to calibrate rater severity and derive fair average scores across ten analytic aspects and holistic proficiency. We compare the analytic scoring performance of human operational raters and three large language models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting. Our results show that LLMs tend to outperform single human raters in identifying relative weaknesses (negative feedback) across several proficiency aspects, while human raters remain stronger at identifying relative strengths (positive feedback). Overall, our findings highlight the limitations of rank-based evaluation for analytic assessment and demonstrate the value of intra-learner, profile-based methods for assessing and deploying LLMs in AES.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于学习者内部强弱项分析的自参考评估框架，替代传统基于排名的相关指标来评估自动作文评分系统，实验表明LLM在识别相对弱点方面优于人工评分者，而人类在识别相对优势方面更胜一筹。
AI.motivation: 传统基于排名的相关性指标无法揭示分析性评分的真实诊断行为，因为其掩盖了分析维度间的内在相关性和光环效应，导致高相关系数可能掩盖系统的真实诊断能力。
AI.method: 提出自参考评估框架，聚焦于识别学习者内部的优缺点而非跨学习者排名；使用ICNALE GRA数据集，采用双面Rasch模型校准评分者严厉度；在零样本设置下比较人类评分者与三个大语言模型的分析性评分表现。
AI.result: LLM在识别相对弱点（负面反馈）方面优于单个人类评分者，而人类评分者在识别相对优势（正面反馈）方面更强。
AI.conclusion: 基于排名的评估方法在分析性评分中存在局限性，基于学习者内部轮廓的方法对于评估和部署LLM进行自动作文评分具有重要价值。

title: The Scaling Properties of Implicit Deductive Reasoning in Transformers
summary: We investigate the scaling properties of implicit deductive reasoning over Horn clauses in depth-bounded Transformers. By systematically decorrelating provability from spurious features and enforcing algorithmic alignment, we find that in sufficiently deep models with a bidirectional prefix mask, implicit reasoning approaches explicit CoT performance across graph topologies and problem widths, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了深度有界Transformer在Horn子句隐式演绎推理中的缩放性质，发现足够深的双向前缀掩码模型可使隐式推理接近显式思维链性能，但深度外推仍需思维链。
AI.motivation: 探索深度有界Transformer在隐式演绎推理中的缩放性质，厘清推理能力与模型深度、结构的关系。
AI.method: 通过系统去相关证明性与虚假特征，并强制执行算法对齐，在不同图拓扑和问题宽度上评估双向前缀掩码模型的隐式推理表现。
AI.result: 足够深的双向前缀掩码模型中，隐式推理在多种图拓扑和问题宽度上接近显式思维链性能。
AI.conclusion: 隐式推理在深度足够时可接近显式思维链效果，但深度外推场景下思维链仍不可替代。

title: SWAN: Semantic Watermarking with Abstract Meaning Representation
summary: We introduce SWAN (Semantic Watermarking with Abstract Meaning Representation), a novel framework that embeds watermark signatures into the semantic structure of a sentence using Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR). In contrast to existing watermarking methods, which typically encode signatures by adjusting token selection preferences during text generation, SWAN embeds the signature directly in the sentence's semantic representation. As the signature is encoded at the semantic structure level, any paraphrase that preserves meaning automatically preserves the signature. SWAN is training-free: watermark injection is achieved by prompting an LLM to generate sentences guided by a selected AMR template while maintaining contextual coherence, and detection uses an off-the-shelf AMR parser followed by a simple one-proportion z-test. Empirical evaluation on the RealNews benchmark shows SWAN matches state-of-the-art detection performance on unaltered watermarked text, while significantly improving robustness against paraphrasing, increasing detection AUC by up to 13.9 percentage points compared to prior methods. These results demonstrate that SWAN's approach of anchoring watermarks in AMR semantic structures provides a simple, effective, and prompt-based method for robust text provenance verification under paraphrasing, opening new avenues for semantic-level watermarking research.

AI.tldr: SWAN是一种基于抽象语义表示（AMR）的语义水印框架，通过在句子语义结构中嵌入签名来实现文本溯源验证，无需训练，且对改写具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有水印方法通常在文本生成时调整token选择偏好，这种方式对语义层面的改写（如释义）鲁棒性较差。因此，本文提出将水印嵌入到语义结构层面，以提升对释义攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.method: SWAN通过提示LLM根据选定的AMR模板生成句子来嵌入签名，检测时使用现成的AMR解析器提取结构，再通过简单的单比例z检验进行判别。整个过程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在RealNews基准上，SWAN在未改写的文本上达到与最先进方法相当的检测性能，而在面对释义攻击时，检测AUC相比先前方法提升了高达13.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SWAN证明了将水印锚定在AMR语义结构中是一种简单、有效且基于提示的方法，能够显著提升释义场景下的文本溯源验证鲁棒性，为语义级水印研究开辟了新方向。

title: Hierarchical Visual Agent: Managing Contexts in Joint Image-Text Space for Advanced Chart Reasoning
summary: Advanced chart question answering requires both precise perception of small visual elements and multi-step reasoning across several subplots. While existing MLLMs are strong at understanding single plots, they often struggle with multi-step reasoning across multiple subplots. We propose HierVA, a hierarchical visual agent framework for chart reasoning that iteratively constructs and updates a working context in a joint image--text space. A high-level manager generates plans and maintains a compact context containing only key information, while specialized workers perform reasoning, gather evidence, and return results. In particular, the agent maintains separate visual and textual contexts, using a zoom-in tool to restrict the visual context. Experiments on the CharXiv reasoning subset demonstrate consistent improvements over strong multimodal baselines, and ablation studies verify that hierarchical architecture, scoped visual context, and distilled context contribute complementary gains.

AI.tldr: 提出HierVA分层视觉智能体框架，通过迭代构建联合图像-文本工作上下文，利用高层管理者和专门工作者协同，在CharXiv推理子集上超越强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在理解单图时表现良好，但在跨多子图的复杂推理和微小视觉元素精确感知方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出HierVA分层视觉智能体框架：高层管理者生成计划并维护紧凑上下文，专门工作者执行推理、收集证据并返回结果；维护分离的视觉和文本上下文，利用缩放工具限制视觉范围。
AI.result: 在CharXiv推理子集上取得一致改进，消融实验验证了分层架构、限定视觉上下文和精简上下文的互补增益。
AI.conclusion: HierVA通过分层架构和视觉-文本联合工作上下文有效提升了图表问答的多步推理能力。

title: When Context Hurts: The Crossover Effect of Knowledge Transfer on Multi-Agent Design Exploration
comment: 16 pages, 14 tables. 2,700 multi-agent experiments across 10 software design tasks, 7 artifact conditions, and 4 convergence pressure levels
summary: The prevailing assumption in agent orchestration is that more context is better. We test this on multi-agent software design across 10 tasks, 7 context-injection conditions, and over 2,700 runs, and find a crossover effect: the same artifact type improves design exploration on some tasks (up to 20$\times$ tradeoff coverage) and actively degrades it on others (up to 46% reduction). On several tasks, an irrelevant document performs as well as or better than every relevant artifact. The direction is predicted by a single measurable variable--baseline exploration without context--with Pearson $r = -0.82$ ($p < 0.001$). Probing the mechanism by manipulating convergence pressure through prompt design reveals two distinct regimes: convergence driven by training data priors (natural) responds to artifact disruption, while convergence driven by explicit instructions (induced) does not. The implication is that context injection should be conditional, not universal: one no-context trial is a cheap diagnostic that predicts whether knowledge artifacts will help or hurt a given task.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多智能体软件设计中，上下文注入存在交叉效应：同一类文档在不同任务上可能提升（最高20倍）或降低（最高46%）设计探索效果，且这种方向可通过无上下文基线探索度单一变量预测（r=-0.82）。建议采用条件式上下文注入，一次无上下文试验即可作为低成本诊断。
AI.motivation: 挑战智能体编排中“更多上下文更好”的主流假设，探究上下文注入是否以及为何会在不同任务中产生相反效果。
AI.method: 在10个任务、7种上下文注入条件、超过2700次运行中，测试多智能体软件设计表现，并通过提示工程操控收敛压力来探究机制。
AI.result: 发现交叉效应：同一类文档在某些任务中提升设计探索（最高20倍帕累托覆盖），在另一些任务中则显著降低（最高46%）；部分任务中不相关文档效果不逊于甚至优于相关文档。方向可由基线探索度预测（r=-0.82, p<0.001）。机制上，自然收敛（训练数据先验驱动）受文档干扰，而诱导收敛（显式指令驱动）则不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 上下文注入应是有条件的而非通用的：一次无上下文试验即可作为低成本诊断工具，预测知识文档对特定任务是有益还是有害。

title: NoisyCausal: A Benchmark for Evaluating Causal Reasoning Under Structured Noise
summary: Causal reasoning in natural language requires identifying relevant variables, understanding their interactions, and reasoning about effects and interventions, often under noisy or ambiguous conditions. While large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general reasoning abilities, they struggle to disentangle correlation from causation, particularly when observations are partially incorrect or irrelevant information is present. In this work, we introduce NoisyCausal, a new benchmark designed to evaluate causal reasoning under structured noise. Each instance is generated from a ground-truth causal graph and contextualized with a natural language scenario by injecting controllable forms of noise, such as irrelevant distractors, value perturbations, confounding, and partial observability. Moreover, we propose a modular reasoning framework that combines LLMs with explicit causal structure to address these challenges. Our method prompts the LLM to extract variables, construct a causal graph from context, and then reformulates the reasoning task as a structured prompt grounded in this graph. Rather than relying on statistical patterns alone, the LLM is guided by symbolic structure, enabling more interpretable and robust inference. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms standard prompting and reasoning baselines on NoisyCausal. Furthermore, it generalizes well to external benchmarks such as Cladder without task-specific tuning. Our findings highlight the importance of combining causal abstractions with language-driven reasoning to achieve faithful and robust causal understanding in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoisyCausal基准和模块化因果推理框架，通过显式因果图引导LLM推理，在含噪环境下显著优于标准方法。
AI.motivation: LLM在因果推理中难以区分相关性与因果性，尤其在存在噪声、错误信息或无关干扰时表现不佳，现有基准缺乏对结构化噪声的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建NoisyCausal基准，基于真实因果图生成含四种噪声（无关干扰、值扰动、混杂、部分可观测）的实例；提出模块化框架，引导LLM提取变量、构建因果图，并基于图结构进行结构化推理。
AI.result: 该方法在NoisyCausal上显著优于标准提示和推理基线，且无需任务特定调整即可泛化到Cladder等外部基准。
AI.conclusion: 结合因果抽象与语言驱动推理对实现LLM忠实且鲁棒的因果理解至关重要。

title: Deployment-Relevant Alignment Cannot Be Inferred from Model-Level Evaluation Alone
summary: Alignment evaluation in machine learning has largely become evaluation of models. Influential benchmarks score model outputs under fixed inputs, such as truthfulness, instruction following, or pairwise preference, and these scores are often used to support claims about deployed alignment. This paper argues that deployment-relevant alignment cannot be inferred from model-level evaluation alone. Alignment claims should instead be indexed to the level at which evidence is collected: model-level, response-level, interaction-level, or deployment-level. Two studies support this position. First, a structured audit of eleven alignment benchmarks, extended to a sixteen-benchmark corpus, dual-coded against an eight-dimension rubric with Cohen's kappa = 0.87, finds that user-facing verification support is absent across every benchmark examined, while process steerability is nearly absent. The few interactional benchmarks identified, including tau-bench, CURATe, Rifts, and Common Ground, remain fragmented in coverage, and benchmark construction rather than data source determines what is measured. Second, a blinded cross-model stress test using 180 transcripts across three frontier models and four scaffolds finds that the same verification scaffold raises one model's verification support to ceiling while leaving another categorically unchanged. This shows that scaffold efficacy is model-dependent and that the gap identified by the audit cannot be closed at the model level alone. We propose a system-level evaluation agenda: alignment profiles instead of single scores, fixed-scaffolding protocols for comparable interactional evaluation, and reporting templates that make the inferential distance between evaluation evidence and deployment claims explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了机器学习中的对齐评估不能仅依赖模型级评估，而应在模型级、响应级、交互级和部署级四个层次上进行。通过对11个对齐基准的结构化审计（扩展至16个基准）和一项交叉模型压力测试，发现用户端验证支持和过程可操控性严重缺失，且支架有效性取决于模型。研究提出系统级评估议程，包括对齐画像、固定支架协议和明确评估证据与部署声明之间推理距离的报告模板。
AI.motivation: 当前对齐评估主要基于模型级评估（如固定输入下的评分），但这类评估无法有效推断部署环境中的对齐表现。作者试图揭示这一推理鸿沟，并证明需要多层次、系统级的评估框架。
AI.method: 研究分两部分：（1）对11个对齐基准的结构化审计（扩展至16个基准），按八维度评分表进行双编码（Cohen's kappa=0.87）；（2）一项盲法交叉模型压力测试，使用180份转录文本，涉及三个前沿模型和四种支架。
AI.result: 所有被审查的基准均缺乏用户端验证支持，过程可操控性几乎完全缺失。少数交互式基准覆盖面碎片化。压力测试显示，相同的验证支架将一个模型的验证支持提升至最高水平，而对另一个模型则毫无改变，表明支架效果具有模型依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 模型级评估不足以推断部署对齐，应转向系统级评估，包括对齐画像、固定支架协议和明确推理解释的报告格式。

title: Telegraph English: Semantic Prompt Compression via Structured Symbolic Rewriting
summary: We introduce Telegraph English (TE), a prompt-compression protocol that rewrites natural language into a symbol-rich, formally-structured dialect. Where token-deletion methods such as LLMLingua-2 train a classifier to delete low-importance tokens at a fixed ratio, TE performs a full semantic rewrite: it decomposes the input into atomic fact lines, substitutes verbose phrases with $\sim$40 logical and relational symbols, and lets the compression ratio adapt to each document's information density. A consequence of the line-structure rule is that compression and semantic chunking become the same operation -- each output line is an independently addressable fact, so the compressed representation is simultaneously a semantic index. We evaluate TE on 4{,}081 question-answer pairs from LongBench-v2 across five OpenAI models and two difficulty levels. At roughly 50\% token reduction, TE preserves 99.1\% accuracy on key facts with GPT-4.1 and outperforms LLMLingua-2 at matched compression ratios on every model and task tested. The gap widens on smaller models -- up to 11 percentage points on fine-detail tasks -- suggesting that explicit relational structure compensates for limited model capacity. We release the grammar specification, compression prompt, benchmark data, and reference implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Telegraph English (TE)协议，通过对自然语言进行语义重写（分解为原子事实行、插入约40种逻辑符号）实现提示压缩，在50%令牌压缩率下保持99.1%的关键事实准确率，且在小模型上优势更明显（最高提升11个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 现有令牌删除类压缩方法（如LLMLingua-2）按固定比率删除低重要性令牌，缺乏语义结构保留，导致压缩后信息丢失严重，尤其在小模型上表现不佳。
AI.method: TE将输入分解为原子事实行，用约40种逻辑和关系符号替代冗长短语，压缩率自适应文档信息密度；输出每一行都是独立可寻址的事实，压缩与语义分块合二为一。
AI.result: 在LongBench-v2的4,081个问答对上，50%令牌压缩下GPT-4.1关键事实准确率99.1%，在所有模型和任务上均优于LLMLingua-2；小模型在细粒度任务上最高提升11个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式的关系结构能够补偿有限模型容量，TE方法不仅压缩效果好，还同时构建了语义索引，是一个高效的提示压缩协议。

title: Intermediate Representations are Strong AI-Generated Image Detectors
summary: The rapid advancement in generative AI models has enabled the creation of photorealistic images. At the same time, there are growing concerns about the potential misuse and dangers of generated content, as well as a pressing need for effective AI-generated image detectors. However, current training-based detection techniques are typically computationally costly and can hardly be generalized to unseen data domains, while training-free methods fall short in detection performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a search-based method employing data embedding sensitivity in intermediate layers to detect AI-generated images. Given a set of real and AI-generated images, our method examines the similarity between original image embeddings and perturbed image embeddings, and detects AI-generated images based on the similarity. We examine the proposed method on two comprehensive benchmarks: GenImage and Forensics Small. Our method exhibits improved performance across different datasets compared to both training-free and training-based state-of-the-art methods. On average, our method achieves the largest performance gain on the Forensics Small benchmark by 39.61% compared to the best training-free method and 5.14% compared to the best training-based method in AUROC score.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于中间层数据嵌入敏感性的搜索方法，通过比较原始图像与扰动图像嵌入的相似性来检测AI生成图像，在GenImage和Forensics Small基准上均优于现有方法，在Forensics Small上AUROC比最优无训练方法高39.61%，比最优有训练方法高5.14%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法中，基于训练的技术计算成本高且难以泛化到未见数据域，而无训练方法检测性能不足，因此需要一种既高效又准确的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于搜索的方法，利用中间层数据嵌入敏感性，通过计算原始图像嵌入与扰动图像嵌入之间的相似度来区分真实图像和AI生成图像。
AI.result: 在GenImage和Forensics Small两个基准上均取得改进；在Forensics Small上AUROC相比最优无训练方法提升39.61%，相比最优有训练方法提升5.14%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在检测性能上优于现有无训练和基于训练的最先进方法，且具有更好的泛化能力。

title: How Does Thinking Mode Change LLM Moral Judgments? A Controlled Instant-vs-Thinking Comparison Across Five Frontier Models
summary: We evaluate whether enabling provider-exposed reasoning mode changes moral judgments within the same model checkpoint. Across 100 moral-judgment scenarios and five frontier reasoning-trained LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3 Flash, DeepSeek V3.1, and Qwen3.5 397B), aggregate binary-verdict agreement remains high and statistically indistinguishable between instant and thinking modes (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.78 vs. 0.79). However, disagreement is concentrated in 21 model-disputed scenarios, where instant-mode agreement is near chance (alpha = 0.08). On these scenarios, reasoning directionally narrows cross-model disagreement, increasing mean pairwise agreement from 5.4 to 6.7 out of 10. Reasoning also reduces demographic-judgment inconsistency in three of five models and does not increase it for any model. Across all five model families, reasoning changes self-labeled ethical frameworks more often than binary verdicts.

AI.tldr: 在100个道德判断场景中，五个前沿推理型LLM的即时模式与思考模式在总体二元判断上高度一致（alpha=0.78 vs 0.79），但在21个模型争议场景中，思考模式缩小了跨模型分歧（平均配对一致性从5.4提升到6.7），且3/5模型的人口统计判断不一致性降低。推理改变自我标注的伦理框架的频率高于改变二元判决。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在启用推理模式（思考模式）时，是否会影响其道德判断的一致性、跨模型分歧程度以及人口统计偏见。
AI.method: 使用100个道德判断场景，对5个前沿推理型LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3 Flash, DeepSeek V3.1, Qwen3.5 397B）在即时模式与思考模式下进行对比，测量二元判决一致性（Krippendorff's alpha）、跨模型配对一致性、人口统计判断不一致性及伦理框架自标签变化。
AI.result: 总体二元判决一致性高且无显著差异（alpha=0.78 vs 0.79）；21个争议场景中即时模式一致性接近随机（alpha=0.08），思考模式将平均配对一致性从5.4提升至6.7；3/5模型的人口统计判断不一致性降低，无模型增加；推理改变伦理框架的频率高于改变二元判决。
AI.conclusion: 推理模式在不显著改变模型整体道德判断方向的前提下，能够在争议性场景中缩小跨模型分歧并减少部分人口统计偏见，但其主要影响体现在伦理框架的自我标签而非具体判决结果。

title: GEM: Graph-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts with ReAct Agents for Dialogue State Tracking
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to AAAI 2026. Also available at Amazon Science: https://www.amazon.science/publications/gem-graph-enhanced-mixture-of-experts-with-react-agents-for-dialogue-state-tracking
summary: Dialogue State Tracking (DST) requires precise extraction of structured information from multi-domain conversations, a task where Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle despite their impressive general capabilities. We present GEM (Graph-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts), a novel framework that combines language models and graph-structured dialogue understanding with ReAct agent-based reasoning for superior DST performance. Our approach dynamically routes between specialized experts: a Graph Neural Network that captures dialogue structure and turn-level dependencies, and a finetuned T5-Small encoder-decoder for sequence modeling, coordinated by an intelligent router. For complex value generation tasks, we integrate ReAct agents that perform structured reasoning over dialogue context. On MultiWOZ 2.2, GEM achieves 65.19% Joint Goal Accuracy, substantially outperforming end-to-end LLM approaches (best: 38.43%) and surpassing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods including TOATOD (63.79%), D3ST (58.70%), and Diable (56.48%). Our graph-enhanced mixture-of-experts architecture with ReAct integration demonstrates that combining structured dialogue representation with dynamic expert routing and agent-based reasoning provides a powerful paradigm for dialogue state tracking, achieving superior accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency through selective expert activation.

AI.tldr: GEM是一种结合图神经网络、混合专家模型和ReAct智能体推理的对话状态跟踪框架，在MultiWOZ 2.2数据集上以65.19%的联合目标准确率大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在通用任务上表现优异，但在多领域对话状态跟踪（精确提取结构化信息）方面仍存在困难，亟需更有效的结构化建模方法。
AI.method: 提出GEM框架，包含：(1) 动态路由的混合专家架构，结合图神经网络（捕获对话结构与轮次依赖）和微调T5-Small序列模型；(2) ReAct智能体用于复杂值生成任务中的结构化推理。
AI.result: 在MultiWOZ 2.2数据集上，GEM达到65.19%的联合目标准确率，远超端到端LLM方法（最佳38.43%），并超越SOTA方法TOATOD（63.79%）、D3ST（58.70%）和Diable（56.48%）。
AI.conclusion: 结合结构化对话表示、动态专家路由与智能体推理是对话状态跟踪的有效范式，能在保持计算效率的同时实现卓越的准确率。

title: Optimize-at-Capture: Highly-adaptive Exposure Controlling for In-Vehicle Non-contact Heart-rate Monitoring
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) holds great promise for continuous heart-rate monitoring of drivers in intelligent vehicles. However, its performance is severely degraded by the highly dynamic illumination changes. A critical yet overlooked factor is the lack of exposure controlling during video acquisition -- most existing systems rely on either fixed exposure settings or camera build-in auto-exposure, both of which fail to maintain stable facial brightness under rapidly changing lighting conditions during driving. To address this gap, we propose a highly-adaptive exposure controlling framework that proactively adjusts exposure parameters based on predictive modeling of historical skin reflections. Unlike standard auto-exposure, our method is specifically optimized for rPPG measurement, ensuring the skin region of interest (ROI) remains within the optimal dynamic range for rPPG signal extraction. As an important contribution of this study, we introduce ExpDrive, a public in-vehicle physiological monitoring dataset comprising synchronized facial video and reference ECG from 48 subjects captured under real driving conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms fixed exposure and standard auto-exposure strategies. Specifically, it reduces the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) by 6.31 bpm (from 14.1 to 7.79 bpm) and significantly increases the success rate by 32.3 percentage points (p < 0.001) (from 24.9% to 57.2%) across challenging driving scenarios. Notably, it clearly improved the performance of non-contact heart-rate monitoring in both low-light (rainy) and high-glare (sunny) conditions, validating the efficacy of exposure-aware acquisition design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向驾驶场景的rPPG自适应曝光控制框架，通过历史皮肤反射预测调整曝光参数，并发布真实驾驶环境数据集ExpDrive，显著提升心率监测精度（MAE从14.1降至7.79 bpm，成功率从24.9%提升至57.2%）。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG系统在驾驶场景中受剧烈光照变化影响性能严重下降，而视频采集时缺乏曝光控制——固定曝光或相机内置自动曝光均无法在快速变化光照下维持面部亮度稳定，亟需一种针对rPPG测量优化的自适应曝光方案。
AI.method: 提出一种基于历史皮肤反射预测建模的自适应曝光控制框架，主动调整曝光参数，确保皮肤ROI区域始终处于rPPG信号提取的最优动态范围；同时构建了包含48名受试者的真实驾驶场景数据集ExpDrive。
AI.result: 相比固定曝光和标准自动曝光，MAE降低6.31 bpm（14.1→7.79 bpm），成功率提升32.3个百分点（24.9%→57.2%），在雨天低光和晴天强眩光条件下均显著改善非接触心率监测性能。
AI.conclusion: 曝光感知的采集设计对提升驾驶场景下rPPG心率监测的鲁棒性至关重要，所提方法有效应对了动态光照挑战，为智能车辆中非接触生理监测提供了可行方案。

title: From Parameter Dynamics to Risk Scoring : Quantifying Sample-Level Safety Degradation in LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Safety alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is extremely fragile, as fine-tuning on a small number of benign samples can erase safety behaviors learned from millions of preference examples. Existing studies attempt to explain this phenomenon by comparing parameters and hidden states before and after fine-tuning, but overlook their dynamic evolution during fine-tuning. In this paper, we uncover a critical mechanism underlying safety degradation by analyzing parameter dynamics, where benign fine-tuning causes parameters to cumulatively drift toward danger-aligned directions, progressively undermining the model's safety. This finding suggests that samples contributing more to this drift has greater fine-tuning risks. Based on this insight, we propose a method of Sample-Level Quantification of Safety Degradation (SQSD), which quantifies the influence of each training sample on safety degradation. Specifically, SQSD computes continuous risk scores to samples by measuring their induced parameter updates' projection difference between danger and safety directions. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that SQSD effectively quantifies sample-level fine-tuning risks and exhibits strong transferability across model architectures, parameter scales, and parameter-efficient methods.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了良性微调导致LLM安全退化的关键机制：参数会累积性地向危险方向漂移。提出SQSD方法，通过计算参数更新的投影差异来量化每个样本对安全退化的影响，实验证明该方法有效且具有跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽发现少量良性样本的微调就能破坏LLM的安全对齐，但仅停留在对比微调前后的参数和隐藏状态，忽视了微调过程中的动态演化。本文旨在从参数动态演化的角度揭示安全退化的关键机制。
AI.method: 提出SQSD（样本级安全退化量化）方法：通过测量每个训练样本诱导的参数更新在危险方向和安全方向之间的投影差异，为样本计算连续的风险分数，从而量化其对安全退化的影响。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，SQSD能够有效量化样本级的微调风险，并且在不同模型架构、参数规模和参数高效方法之间表现出强迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 参数向危险方向累积漂移是微调导致安全退化的关键机制，SQSD方法可有效识别高风险样本，为安全微调提供预警和指导。

title: DoGMaTiQ: Automated Generation of Question-and-Answer Nuggets for Report Evaluation
summary:
Evaluation of long-form, citation-backed reports has lately received significant attention due to the wide-scale adoption of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Core to many evaluation frameworks is the use of atomic facts, or nuggets, to assess a report's coverage of query-relevant information attested in the underlying collection. While nuggets have traditionally been represented as short statements, recent work has used question-answer (QA) representations, enabling fine-grained evaluations that decouple the information need (i.e. the question) from the potentially diverse content that satisfies it (i.e. its answers).
  A persistent challenge for nugget-based evaluation is the need to manually curate sets of nuggets for each topic in a test collection -- a laborious process that scales poorly to novel information needs. This challenge is acute in cross-lingual settings, where information is found in multilingual source documents. Accordingly, we introduce DoGMaTiQ, a pipeline for generating high-quality QA-based nugget sets in three stages: (1) document-grounded nugget generation, (2) paraphrase clustering, and (3) nugget subselection based on principled quality criteria. We integrate DoGMaTiQ nuggets with AutoArgue -- a recent nugget-based evaluation framework -- to enable fully automatic evaluation of generated reports. We conduct extensive experiments on two cross-lingual TREC shared tasks, NeuCLIR and RAGTIME, showing strong rank correlations with both human-in-the-loop and fully manual judgments. Finally, detailed analysis of our pipeline reveals that a strong LLM nugget generator is key, and that the system rankings induced by DoGMaTiQ are robust to outlier systems. We facilitate future research in report evaluation by publicly releasing our code and artifacts at https://github.com/manestay/dogmatiq.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoGMaTiQ流水线，用于自动生成跨语言环境下基于QA的原子事实（nugget）集合，并集成到AutoArgue框架中实现检索增强生成（RAG）系统生成报告的自动评估。实验证明该方法在两项跨语言TREC任务上取得了与人工评估高度相关的排序结果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于nugget的评估方法需要为每个主题手动构建nugget集合，成本高昂且难以扩展到新领域，尤其在跨语言场景下问题更为突出。因此需要一种自动生成高质量nugget的方法来支撑大规模报告评估。
AI.method: DoGMaTiQ流水线包含三个阶段：(1) 基于文档的nugget生成，(2) 释义聚类，(3) 基于质量标准的原则性子选择。生成的QA格式nugget集成到AutoArgue框架中，实现报告的全自动评估。
AI.result: 在NeuCLIR和RAGTIME两个跨语言TREC任务上，DoGMaTiQ与人工参与及完全人工评估结果均表现出强秩相关性。分析表明，强大的LLM nugget生成器是关键，且系统排名对离群系统具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DoGMaTiQ能够有效替代昂贵的手动nugget构建过程，实现跨语言RAG报告的全自动评估。代码和构件已开源以促进后续研究。

title: Detecting Deepfakes via Hamiltonian Dynamics
summary: Driven by the rapid development of generative AI models, deepfake detectors are compelled to undergo periodic recalibration to capture newly developed synthetic artifacts. To break this cycle, we propose a new perspective on deepfake detection: moving from static pattern recognition to dynamical stability analysis. Specifically, our approach is motivated by physics-inspired priors: we hypothesize that natural images, as products of dissipative physical processes, tend to settle near stable, low-energy equilibria. In contrast, generative models optimize for statistical similarity to real images but do not explicitly enforce structural constraints such as geometric smoothness, leaving deepfakes more likely to occupy unstable, high-energy states. To operationalize this, we introduce Hamiltonian Action Anomaly Detection (HAAD), comprising three contributions: \textbf{i)} We model the image latent manifold as a potential energy surface. Under this hypothesis, real images are expected to produce basin-like low-energy responses, whereas fake images are more likely to induce high-potential, high-gradient responses. \textbf{ii)} We employ Hamiltonian-inspired dynamics as a stability probe. By releasing latent states from rest, samples near stable regions remain bounded, while high-gradient samples produce larger trajectory responses. \textbf{iii)} We quantify these dynamic behaviors through two trajectory statistics, \ie, Hamiltonian action and energy dissipation. Extensive experiments show that HAAD outperforms evaluated state-of-the-art baselines on challenging cross-dataset transfer benchmarks, supporting a physics-inspired stability prior for digital forensics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于物理启发的哈密顿动力学稳定性分析方法（HAAD）进行深度伪造检测，通过将图像潜在流形建模为势能面，利用真实图像趋于低能稳定态、伪造图像处于高能不稳态的物理先验，在跨数据集迁移任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器需要随生成模型迭代而不断重新校准，陷入静态模式识别的循环。作者希望打破这一循环，从动态稳定性分析的新视角出发，引入物理学先验进行伪造检测。
AI.method: 1) 将图像潜在流形建模为势能面，真实图像为低能稳定盆地，伪造图像为高能高梯度区域；2) 采用哈密顿动力学作为稳定性探针，从静止释放潜状态，稳定区域样本轨迹受限，高梯度样本产生大轨迹响应；3) 通过哈密顿作用和能量耗散两个轨迹统计量量化动态行为。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的跨数据集迁移基准上，HAAD方法超越了所评估的现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 物理启发的稳定性先验可以有效用于数字取证中的深度伪造检测，打破传统依赖周期性重新校准的模式。

title: SensingAgents: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Robust IMU Activity Recognition
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors is a cornerstone of mobile health, smart environments, and human-computer interaction. However, current deep learning-based HAR models often struggle with heavy reliance on labeled data, position-specific ambiguity, and a lack of transparent reasoning. Inspired by the advanced agents framework, which emulates a collaborative agent using Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose SensingAgents, a novel multi-agent system for robust IMU activity recognition. SensingAgents organizes LLM-powered agents into specialized roles: a group of Analyst Agents for position-specific sensor analysis (arm, wrist, belt, pocket), a pair of Advocate Agents that resolves sensor conflicts through dynamic and static dialectical debates, and a Decision Agent that ensures reliability under sensor drift or failure. Evaluation on the Shoaib dataset demonstrates that SensingAgents significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent LLM models, achieving an accuracy of 79.5% in a zero setting--29% higher than existing agent models and 9.4% higher than deep learning baselines--particularly in complex scenarios where multi-sensor data is conflicting or noisy. Our work highlights the potential of multi-agent collaborative reasoning for advancing the robustness and interpretability of ubiquitous sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SensingAgents，一种基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，通过分析师、辩护师和决策智能体的协作，在零样本设置下实现IMU人体活动识别，准确率达79.5%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习HAR模型严重依赖标注数据、存在位置特异性模糊问题且缺乏透明推理能力，亟需一种更鲁棒、可解释的解决方案。
AI.method: 受高级智能体框架启发，SensingAgents将LLM驱动的智能体组织为三类角色：分析师智能体（负责手臂、手腕、腰带、口袋等位置特定传感器分析）、辩护师智能体（通过动态和静态辩证辩论解决传感器冲突）、决策智能体（在传感器漂移或故障时确保可靠性）。
AI.result: 在Shoaib数据集上，SensingAgents零样本准确率达79.5%，比现有智能体模型高29%，比深度学习基线高9.4%，尤其在多传感器数据冲突或噪声场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作推理在提升泛在传感系统的鲁棒性和可解释性方面具有巨大潜力。

title: CAR: Query-Guided Confidence-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) depends on document ranking to provide useful evidence for generation, but conventional reranking methods mainly optimize query-document relevance rather than generation usefulness. A relevant document may still introduce noise, while a lower-ranked document may better reduce the generator's uncertainty. We propose CAR (Confidence-Aware Reranking), a query-guided, training-free, and plug-and-play reranking framework that uses generator confidence change as a document usefulness signal. CAR estimates confidence through the semantic consistency of multiple sampled answers under query-only and query-document conditions. Documents that significantly increase confidence are promoted, those that decrease confidence are demoted, and uncertain cases preserve the baseline order, while a query-level gate avoids unnecessary intervention on already confident queries. Experiments on four BEIR datasets show that CAR consistently improves NDCG@5 across sparse and dense retrievers, LLM-based and supervised rerankers, and four LLM backbones. Notably, CAR improves the YesNo reranker by 25.4 percent on average under Contriever retrieval, and its ranking gains strongly correlate with downstream generation F1 improvements, achieving Spearman rho = 0.964.

AI.tldr: 提出CAR（置信度感知重排序），一种利用生成器置信度变化作为文档有用性信号的即插即用重排序框架，无需训练即可提升RAG系统的文档排序质量。
AI.motivation: 传统重排序方法主要优化查询-文档相关性，而非生成有用性——相关文档可能引入噪声，而低排名文档反而可能降低生成器不确定性。
AI.method: 通过查询仅和查询-文档条件下多个采样答案的语义一致性估计置信度变化，提升置信度的文档被推高，降低的被推低，不确定时保持基线排序，并设置查询级门控避免过度干预。
AI.result: 在四个BEIR数据集上，CAR一致提升NDCG@5；YesNo重排序器提升25.4%；排序增益与生成F1强相关（Spearman ρ=0.964）。
AI.conclusion: CAR是一种有效的、无需训练的重排序方法，通过置信度信号更好地将文档排序与生成质量对齐。

title: UAV as Urban Construction Change Monitor: A New Benchmark and Change Captioning Model
summary: Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning (RSICC) aims to generate spatially grounded natural language descriptions of scene evolution from bi-temporal imagery, moving beyond binary change masks toward semantic-level understanding. However, existing methods rely on implicit feature differencing without explicitly modeling structured change semantics, and struggle to reconcile the conflicting representation demands of change detection and caption generation. In addition, current benchmarks provide limited coverage of high-resolution urban construction scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose PTNet, a prototype-guided task-adaptive framework for joint change captioning and detection. PTNet explicitly models structured change semantics through a learnable prototype bank that guides cross-temporal interaction, disentangles task-specific representations via multi-head gating, and injects detection-derived spatial priors into caption generation, enabling coherent semantic correspondence while preserving fine-grained spatial sensitivity. Furthermore, we construct UCCD, a large-scale UAV-based benchmark comprising 9,000 high-resolution image pairs and 45,000 annotated sentences for urban construction monitoring. Extensive experiments on UCCD and WHU-CDC demonstrate that PTNet consistently outperforms existing methods. The dataset and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/G124556/ptnet.

AI.tldr: 提出PTNet框架，通过原型引导和任务自适应机制联合完成遥感图像变化字幕生成与变化检测，并构建了大规模无人机城市建造数据集UCCD。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖隐式特征差分，缺乏对结构化变化语义的显式建模，难以协调变化检测与字幕生成的表示冲突，且缺乏高分辨率城市建造场景数据。
AI.method: 提出PTNet，包含可学习原型库引导跨时交互、多头门控解耦任务特定表示、检测空间先验注入字幕生成，实现联合变化字幕生成与检测。
AI.result: 在UCCD和WHU-CDC数据集上，PTNet持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模结构化变化语义与任务自适应机制有效提升了变化字幕生成与检测性能，UCCD数据集填补了高分辨率城市建造场景的空白。

title: AuditRepairBench: A Paired-Execution Trace Corpus for Evaluator-Channel Ranking Instability in Agent Repair
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and D Directions Track
summary: Agent-repair leaderboards reorder under evaluator reconfiguration, and a measurable share of the reordering is produced by methods that consult evaluator-derived signal during internal selection of candidate repairs. We document this failure mode on a public leaderboard and release AuditRepairBench, a paired-execution trace corpus of 576,000 registered cells (96,000 executed) that operationalizes evaluator-channel-blocking ranking instability within a declared observability boundary. A modular screening architecture decides pathway-blocking through four interchangeable implementations, a learned influence proxy, a rule-based channel-exposure ratio that uses no trained model, a counterfactual sensitivity proxy, and a sparse human-audit proxy, combined into a screening posterior that feeds a cell-level flip functional, a set-valued label, a stratified system score, and a set-valued leaderboard. The resource is supported by mechanism-anchored validation on an 80-case source-level channel-surgery subset, an independent-discovery protocol under which two annotator groups separated from the pipeline developers discover coupling patterns blinded to the screening design and the frozen ensemble attains pooled AUROC 0.83 on their 79 cases, implementation robustness, uncertainty propagation that raises 95% coverage from 0.81 to 0.95, and forward transfer with pooled community-evaluator Spearman \r{ho} = 0.65. Screening-guided blinding patches reduce rank displacement by 55--74% (mean 62%) at fewer than 50 lines of code, whereas random channel blinding produces at most 7% reduction and generic retraining at most 13%. AuditRepairBench-Lite, a rule-only configuration on a 12,000-cell subset, preserves the leaderboard at Kendall τ = 0.88 under twenty-four GPU-hours and is the primary release artifact at 42 GB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuditRepairBench数据集和筛选方法，用于检测和缓解评估器通道泄露导致的代码修复排行榜排序不稳定性。该方法通过四种筛选代理检测通道泄露，仅需少量代码即可将排名位移降低55–74%。
AI.motivation: 现有代码修复排行榜在评估器配置发生变化时会出现排序重新排列，部分重新排列是由于在候选修复内部选择过程中使用了源自评估器的信号（即评估器通道泄露），但缺乏系统化的检测和缓解手段。
AI.method: 构建AuditRepairBench数据集（576,000个注册单元格，96,000个已执行）；设计模块化筛选架构，包含四种可互换的通道检测代理（学习型影响代理、基于规则的通道暴露比、反事实敏感性代理、稀疏人工审计代理）；通过筛选后验生成单元格级翻转函数、集值标签、分层系统分数和集值排行榜；采用机制锚定验证、独立发现协议和不确定性传播。
AI.result: 筛选引导的盲打补丁仅需不到50行代码即可将排名位移降低55–74%（平均62%），而随机通道盲打最多降低7%，通用重训练最多降低13%。冻结集成在独立标注组上的池化AUROC达到0.83，不确定性传播将95%覆盖率从0.81提升至0.95。
AI.conclusion: 评估器通道泄露是排行榜排序不稳定的重要来源，所提出的筛选方法能够有效检测并缓解该问题，且开销极低。AuditRepairBench-Lite轻量版本在24 GPU小时内可保持Kendall τ=0.88的排行榜一致性。

title: SCOUT: Active Information Foraging for Long-Text Understanding with Decoupled Epistemic States
summary: Long-Text Understanding (LTU) at million-token scale requires balancing reasoning fidelity with computational efficiency. Frontier long-context LLMs can process millions of token contexts end-to-end, but they suffer from high token consumption and attention dilution. In parallel, specialized LTU agents often sacrifice fidelity through task-agnostic abstractions like graph construction or indexing. We identify a key insight for LTU: query-relevant information is typically sparse relative to the full document, so effective reasoning should rely on a query-sufficient subset rather than the entire context. To address this, we propose SCOUT, a new paradigm for LTU that shifts from passive processing to active information foraging. It treats the document as an explorable environment and answers from a compact, provenance-grounded epistemic state.
