Guided by state-level gap diagnosis, SCOUT adaptively alternates between coarse-to-fine exploration and anchored state updates that progressively contract its epistemic state toward query sufficiency. Experiments show that SCOUT matches state-of-the-art proprietary models while reducing token consumption by up to 8x. Moreover, SCOUT remains stable as context length scales, substantially alleviating the practical cost-performance trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOUT范式，通过主动信息搜索替代被动全量处理，在百万级token长文本理解中实现与SOTA模型相当的性能，同时将token消耗降低8倍。
AI.motivation: 现有长文本理解方法存在两难：端到端长上下文LLM存在token消耗高和注意力稀释问题；专用LTU智能体通过任务无关的抽象（如图构建）牺牲了保真度。核心洞察是查询相关信息在文档中稀疏分布，无需处理全部上下文。
AI.method: SCOUT将文档视为可探索环境，通过状态级差距诊断自适应地在粗到细的探索与锚定状态更新之间交替，逐步将认知状态收缩至查询充分性。
AI.result: 匹配SOTA专有模型性能，token消耗降低8倍；在上下文长度扩展时保持稳定，显著缓解了成本-性能权衡问题。
AI.conclusion: 从被动处理转向主动信息觅食是长文本理解的有效范式，SCOUT证明了通过查询充分子集进行推理可以在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低计算成本。

title: Evaluation Cards for XAI Metrics
comment: 7 pages. Accepted at the 5th XAI4CV Workshop, CVPR 2026 (non-archival)
summary: The evaluation of explainable AI (XAI) methods is affected by a lack of standardization. Metrics are inconsistently defined, incompletely reported, and rarely validated against common baselines. In this paper, we identify transparency of evaluation reporting as a central, under-addressed problem. We propose the XAI Evaluation Card, a documentation template analogous to model cards, designed to accompany any study that introduces an XAI evaluation metric. The card covers explicit declaration of target properties, grounding levels, metric assumptions, validation evidence, gaming risks, and known failure cases. We argue that adopting this template as a community norm would reduce evaluation fragmentation, support meta-analysis, and improve accountability in XAI research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XAI评估卡，一个用于标准化可解释AI评估指标报告的文件模板，旨在解决评估报告透明度不足的问题。
AI.motivation: XAI评估方法缺乏标准化，指标定义不一致、报告不完整、缺乏基线验证，评估报告透明度是核心问题。
AI.method: 提出XAI Evaluation Card文档模板，类比模型卡，涵盖目标属性声明、基础层次、指标假设、验证证据、博弈风险和已知失败案例等要素。
AI.result: 该模板可减少评估碎片化，支持元分析，提升XAI研究的可问责性。
AI.conclusion: 建议社区将XAI评估卡作为规范采用，以标准化评估报告，改善XAI研究质量。

title: Budget-aware Auto Optimizer Configurator
summary: Optimizer states occupy massive GPU memory in large-scale model training. However, gradients in different network blocks exhibit distinct behaviors, such as varying directional stability and scale anisotropy, implying that expensive optimizer states are not universally necessary and using a global optimizer is often memory-inefficient. We propose the Budget-Aware Optimizer Configurator (BAOC) to reduce memory cost by assigning suitable optimizer configurations to individual blocks under given budgets. Specifically, BAOC samples gradient streams to derive statistical metrics that quantify the potential performance risk of applying cheaper configurations (e.g., low precision or removing momentum). It then solves a constrained allocation problem to minimize total risk under memory and time budgets, selecting a budget-feasible configuration for each block. Experiments across vision, language, and diffusion workloads demonstrate that BAOC maintains training quality while significantly reducing the memory usage of optimizer states. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BAOC-45C6.

AI.tldr: 提出预算感知优化器配置器(BAOC)，通过为不同网络块分配差异化的优化器配置，在给定内存预算下降低优化器状态内存占用，同时保持训练质量。
AI.motivation: 大规模模型训练中优化器状态占用大量GPU内存，但不同网络块的梯度行为存在差异（如方向稳定性、尺度各向异性），全局统一使用昂贵优化器存在内存效率低下的问题。
AI.method: BAOC采样梯度流获取统计指标，量化应用低成本配置（低精度、移除动量等）的潜在性能风险；然后求解受约束的分配问题，在内存和时间预算下最小化总风险，为每个块选择预算可行的配置。
AI.result: 在视觉、语言和扩散模型上的实验表明，BAOC在保持训练质量的同时，显著降低了优化器状态的内存使用。
AI.conclusion: 通过差异化配置优化器状态，可以在不牺牲训练效果的前提下大幅节省内存，是一种内存高效的训练策略。

title: Harnessing Linguistic Dissimilarity for Language Generalization on Unseen Low-Resource Varieties
summary: Low-resource language varieties used by specific groups remain neglected in the development of Multilingual Language Models. A great deal of cross-lingual research focuses on inter-lingual language transfer which strives to align allied varieties and minimize differences between them. However, for low-resource varieties, linguistic dissimilarity is also an important cue allowing generalization to unseen varieties. Unlike prior approaches, we propose a two-stage Language Generalization framework that focuses on capturing variety-specific cues while also exploiting rich overlap offered by high-resource source variety. First, we propose TOPPing, a source-selection method specifically designed for low-resource varieties. Second, we suggest a lightweight VACAI-Bowl architecture that learns variety-specific attributes with one branch while a parallel branch captures variety-invariant attributes using adversarial training. We evaluate our framework on structural prediction tasks, which are among the few tasks available, as proxy for performance on other downstream tasks. Using VACAI-Bowl with TOPPing yields an average 54.62% improvement in the dependency parsing task, which serves as a proxy for performance on other downstream tasks across 10 low-resource varieties.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种两阶段语言泛化框架，通过TOPPing源语言选择和VACAI-Bowl双分支架构，在低资源语言变体的依存句法分析任务上平均提升54.62%。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型中低资源语言变体被忽视，现有跨语言研究过度关注语言间对齐，忽略了变体特异性特征对泛化的价值。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) TOPPing源语言选择方法，专为低资源变体设计；2) VACAI-Bowl轻量级架构，一个分支学习变体特异性属性，另一分支通过对抗训练学习变体不变属性。
AI.result: 在10个低资源语言变体的依存句法分析任务上平均提升54.62%，该任务作为其他下游任务的代理指标。
AI.conclusion: 捕捉变体特异性线索与利用高资源源语言丰富重叠相结合，能有效提升低资源语言变体的泛化性能。

title: Structured 3D Latents Are Surprisingly Powerful: Unleashing Generalizable Style with 2D Diffusion
summary: 3D asset generation plays a pivotal role in fields such as gaming and virtual reality, enabling the rapid synthesis of high-fidelity 3D objects from a single or multiple images. Building on this capability, enabling style-controllable generation naturally emerges as an important and desirable direction. However, existing approaches typically rely on style images that lie within or are similar to the training distribution of 3D generation models. When presented with out-of-distribution (OOD) styles, their performance degrades significantly or even fails. To address this limitation, we introduce $\textbf{DiLAST}$: 2D Diffusion-based Latent Awakening for 3D Style Transfer. Specifically, we leverage a pretrained 2D diffusion model as a teacher to provide rich and generalizable style priors. By aligning rendered views with the target style under diffusion-based guidance, our method optimizes the structured 3D latent representation for stylization. We observe that this limitation stems not from insufficient model capacity, but from the underutilization of structured 3D latents, which are inherently expressive. Despite being trained on comparatively limited data, 3D generation models can leverage 2D diffusion guidance to steer denoising toward specific directions in latent space, thereby producing diverse, OOD styles. Extensive experiments across diverse data and multiple 3D generation backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and plug-and-play nature of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiLAST方法，利用预训练的2D扩散模型作为教师，通过扩散引导对齐渲染视图与目标风格，实现对结构化3D潜表示的风格迁移，能够处理分布外（OOD）风格，且具备即插即用特性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D风格可控生成方法依赖训练分布内或相似的风格图像，面对分布外（OOD）风格时性能显著下降甚至失败，亟需一种能够泛化至任意风格的方法。
AI.method: 利用预训练的2D扩散模型作为教师提供丰富的风格先验，通过扩散引导将渲染视图与目标风格对齐，优化结构化3D潜表示以实现风格化。
AI.result: 在多种数据和多个3D生成骨干网络上验证了方法的有效性和即插即用特性，成功生成多样的OOD风格。
AI.conclusion: 3D生成模型的性能限制并非源于模型容量不足，而是结构化3D潜表示未被充分利用；借助2D扩散引导可有效激活其表达能力，实现OOD风格迁移。

title: Reward-Decomposed Reinforcement Learning for Immersive Video Role-Playing
summary:
Text-based role-playing models can imitate character styles, yet they often fail to reflect a scene's atmosphere and evolving tension, both essential for immersive applications such as Virtual Reality (VR) games and interactive narratives. We study video-grounded role-playing dialogue and introduce EBM-RL (Eye-Brain-Mouth Reinforcement Learning), a decoupled GRPO-based framework that explicitly separates observation ([perception]), reasoning ([think]), and utterance ([answer]). This structure promotes human-like sensory grounding by compelling the model to first attend to visual cues, then form internal interpretations, and finally generate context-appropriate dialogue.
  EBM-RL integrates four complementary rewards: (i) CLIP-based scene-text alignment to improve ambiance and emotion; (ii) a Perceptual-Cognitive reward that encourages [perception] and [think] processes that increase the likelihood of the reference response; (iii) answer accuracy to ensure faithfulness; and (iv) a dense format reward to enforce the desired structured output.
  Extensive experiments demonstrate that EBM-RL substantially outperforms text-only role-playing baselines and larger-scale vision-language models on our immersive role-playing benchmark, delivering simultaneous gains in visual-atmosphere consistency and character authenticity. Beyond the role-playing domain, EBM-RL also exhibits strong zero-shot generalization: without any additional fine-tuning, it consistently improves performance on out-of-domain VideoQA benchmarks. We additionally release an open-source dataset for video-grounded role-playing dialogue.

AI.tldr: 提出EBM-RL框架，通过解耦感知-思考-回答三阶段并结合四种奖励机制，实现视频驱动的角色扮演对话，在沉浸式场景中显著提升氛围一致性和角色真实性，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统文本角色扮演模型能模仿角色风格，但无法反映场景氛围和动态张力，难以满足VR游戏和交互叙事等沉浸式应用的需求。
AI.method: 提出EBM-RL（Eye-Brain-Mouth强化学习）框架，基于解耦的GRPO，将对话分为[感知]、[思考]、[回答]三阶段，集成四种奖励：CLIP场景文本对齐奖励、感知认知奖励、答案准确性奖励、密集格式奖励。
AI.result: 在沉浸式角色扮演基准测试中显著优于文本基线和大规模视觉语言模型，并在VideoQA基准上展现出零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EBM-RL通过结构化的感知-认知-输出流程有效提升了角色扮演的沉浸感，且无附加微调即可泛化至其他视频理解任务。

title: Distilling Bayesian Belief States into Language Models for Auditable Negotiation
comment: Preprint. 24 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables. Code available at https://github.com/kaneis1/CaSiNo_negotiation-agent
summary: Negotiation agents must infer what their counterpart values, update those beliefs over dialogue turns, and choose actions under uncertainty. End-to-end large language models (LLMs) can imitate negotiation dialogue, but their opponent beliefs are usually implicit and difficult to inspect. We propose BOND (Bayesian Opponent-belief Negotiation Distillation), a framework for auditable negotiation. BOND consists of an LLM-based Bayesian teacher that scores dialogue contexts against the six possible opponent priority orderings, updates a posterior over those orderings, and uses the posterior for menu-based decision making, as well as a smaller 8B student language model that emits both negotiation actions and normalized posterior beliefs as tagged text. In the CaSiNo negotiation dataset, BOND outperforms the state-of-the-art and achieves mean Brier score 0.085 over opponent-priority posteriors. The distilled student preserves much of this belief signal, achieving Brier 0.114, below the uniform six-ordering reference of 5/36, approximately 0.139. Compared with a 70B structured-CoT baseline, the significantly smaller 8B student model yields substantially better elicited posterior calibration. We further showcase auditability through posterior trajectories, belief-versus-policy error decomposition, and posterior-prefix interventions. These diagnostics reveal that distillation preserves a scoreable belief report more strongly than causal belief-conditioned control, making weak belief-action coupling visible, not hidden.

AI.tldr: BOND是一个基于贝叶斯推断的谈判智能体框架，通过LLM教师模型更新对手信念后验分布，并将可审计的信念蒸馏到小模型（8B）中，在CaSiNo数据集上达到SOTA性能（Brier 0.085），同时实现了信念的可解释性和可干预性。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端LLM谈判智能体虽然能模仿对话，但其对手信念通常是隐式的、难以检查的，缺乏可审计性。
AI.method: 提出BOND框架：1）基于LLM的贝叶斯教师模型对六种对手优先级排序进行评分并更新后验；2）将后验知识蒸馏到8B学生语言模型，使其同时输出谈判动作和归一化后验信念。
AI.result: 在CaSiNo数据集上，BOND达到SOTA，教师模型Brier分数0.085，学生模型0.114（低于均匀基准5/36≈0.139）；8B学生模型优于70B结构化CoT基线；蒸馏保留了可评分的信念报告。
AI.conclusion: BOND通过信念轨迹、信念-策略误差分解和后验前缀干预实现了可审计性，使弱信念-动作耦合变得可见而非隐藏。

title: Joint Semantic Token Selection and Prompt Optimization for Interpretable Prompt Learning
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong visual-textual alignment, but often suffer from overfitting and limited interpretability when adapted through continuous prompt learning. While discrete prompt optimization improves interpretability, it usually depends on large external models, leading to high computational costs and limited scalability. In this paper, we propose Interpretable Prompt Learning (IPL), a hybrid framework that alternates between discrete semantic token selection and continuous prompt optimization. Specifically, IPL formulates semantic token selection as an approximate submodular optimization problem, encouraging tokens that are both human-understandable and semantically diverse. It further adopts an alternating optimization strategy to integrate discrete token selection with continuous prompt tuning, improving interpretability while preserving adaptability to downstream tasks. Our framework is plug-and-play, allowing seamless integration with existing prompt learning methods. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that IPL consistently improves both interpretability and accuracy across five representative prompt learning methods, providing an effective and scalable extension to existing frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出IPL框架，通过交替优化离散语义令牌选择和连续提示学习，在提升可解释性的同时保持下游任务适应性，且可即插即用地集成到现有提示学习方法中。
AI.motivation: 现有连续提示学习存在过拟合和可解释性差的问题，而离散提示优化虽可解释性强但依赖大型外部模型，计算成本高且扩展性差。
AI.method: 提出IPL混合框架，将语义令牌选择形式化为近似子模优化问题，选择人类可理解且语义多样的令牌，并采用交替优化策略整合离散令牌选择与连续提示调优。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，IPL在五种代表性提示学习方法中一致提升了可解释性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: IPL是一种有效且可扩展的即插即用框架，能够无缝集成到现有提示学习方法中。

title: AgentTrust: Runtime Safety Evaluation and Interception for AI Agent Tool Use
summary:
Modern AI agents execute real-world side effects through tool calls such as file operations, shell commands, HTTP requests, and database queries. A single unsafe action, including accidental deletion, credential exposure, or data exfiltration, can cause irreversible harm. Existing defenses are incomplete: post-hoc benchmarks measure behavior after execution, static guardrails miss obfuscation and multi-step context, and infrastructure sandboxes constrain where code runs without understanding what an action means.
  We present AgentTrust, a runtime safety layer that intercepts agent tool calls before execution and returns a structured verdict: allow, warn, block, or review. AgentTrust combines a shell deobfuscation normalizer, SafeFix suggestions for safer alternatives, RiskChain detection for multi-step attack chains, and a cache-aware LLM-as-Judge for ambiguous inputs.
  We release a 300-scenario benchmark across six risk categories and an additional 630 independently constructed real-world adversarial scenarios. On the internal benchmark, the production-only ruleset achieves 95.0% verdict accuracy and 73.7% risk-level accuracy at low-millisecond end-to-end latency. On the 630-scenario benchmark, evaluated under a patched ruleset and not claimed as zero-shot, AgentTrust achieves 96.7% verdict accuracy, including about 93% on shell-obfuscated payloads. AgentTrust is released under the AGPL-3.0 license and provides a Model Context Protocol server for MCP-compatible agents.

AI.tldr: AgentTrust 是一个运行时安全层，在 AI 代理执行工具调用前进行拦截，返回"允许、警告、阻止、审查"结构化的判决，集成了 Shell 反混淆、SafeFix 安全替代建议、RiskChain 多步攻击链检测和 LLM 裁判机制，在 300 场景内部基准上达到 95.0% 判决准确率，在 630 对抗场景基准上达到 96.7% 判决准确率。
AI.motivation: 现代 AI 代理在执行工具调用（如文件操作、Shell 命令、HTTP 请求、数据库查询）时可能造成不可逆的安全危害（如意外删除、凭证泄露、数据窃取），现有防御措施（事后基准测试、静态防护栏、基础设施沙箱）均不完善。
AI.method: AgentTrust 在工具调用执行前进行运行时拦截，核心组件包括：Shell 反混淆归一化器、SafeFix 安全替代方案建议、RiskChain 多步攻击链检测、以及缓存感知的 LLM 裁判机制，输出四个等级的判决结果。
AI.result: 内部 300 场景基准：生产规则集达到 95.0% 判决准确率、73.7% 风险等级准确率，端到端延迟为低毫秒级；630 场景对抗基准（补丁规则集下评估，非零样本声称）达到 96.7% 判决准确率，其中 Shell 混淆载荷识别约 93%。
AI.conclusion: AgentTrust 以 AGPL-3.0 协议开源，提供 MCP 服务器接口，可作为 AI 代理工具调用的有效运行时安全防护层。

title: RaguTeam at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Meno and Friends in a Judge-Orchestrated LLM Ensemble for Faithful Multi-Turn Response Generation
summary: We present our winning system for Task~B (generation with reference passages) in SemEval-2026 Task~8: MTRAGEval. Our method is a heterogeneous ensemble of seven LLMs with two prompting variants, where a GPT-4o-mini judge selects the best candidate per instance. We ranked 1st out of 26 teams, achieving a conditioned harmonic mean of 0.7827 and outperforming the strongest baseline (gpt-oss-120b, 0.6390). Ablations show that diversity in model families, scales, and prompting strategies is essential, with the ensemble consistently beating any single model. We also introduce Meno-Lite-0.1, a 7B domain-adapted model with a strong cost--performance trade-off, and analyse MTRAGEval, highlighting annotation limitations and directions for improvement. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/RaguTeam/ragu_mtrag_semeval

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在SemEval-2026 Task~B中排名第一的异构集成系统，通过7个LLM的集成和GPT-4o-mini裁判选择最佳候选，取得了0.7827的条件调和平均分，并提出了具有性价比的7B领域适配模型Meno-Lite-0.1。
AI.motivation: 在SemEval-2026 Task~B（含参考段落的生成任务）中，现有基线模型性能有限，需要更优的方法来提升生成质量。
AI.method: 采用7个LLM的异构集成系统，包含两种提示变体，使用GPT-4o-mini作为裁判为每个实例选择最佳候选输出。
AI.result: 在26个参赛队伍中排名第1，条件调和平均分达0.7827，远超最强基线gpt-oss-120b的0.6390；消融实验表明模型家族、规模和提示策略的多样性至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 异构集成方法显著优于单一模型，提出的Meno-Lite-0.1模型在性能与成本间取得良好平衡，同时揭示了MTRAGEval任务中标注的局限性及改进方向。

title: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains to automate complex workflows through long-horizon and high-stakes action executions. Due to their high capability and flexibility, such agents raise significant security and safety concerns. A growing number of real-world incidents have shown that adversaries can easily manipulate agents into performing harmful actions, such as leaking API keys, deleting user data, or initiating unauthorized transactions. Evaluating agent security is inherently challenging, as agents operate in dynamic, untrusted environments involving external tools, heterogeneous data sources, and frequent user interactions. However, realistic, controllable, and reproducible environments for large-scale risk assessment remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce the DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap), the first controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents, spanning 14 real-world domains and over 50 simulation environments that replicate widely used systems such as Google Workspace, Paypal, and Slack. To scale the risk assessment of agents in DTap, we further propose DTap-Red, the first autonomous red-teaming agent that systematically explores diverse injection vectors (e.g., prompt, tool, skill, environment, combinations) and autonomously discovers effective attack strategies tailored to varying malicious goals. Using DTap-Red, we curate DTap-Bench, a large-scale red-teaming dataset comprising high-quality instances across domains, each paired with a verifiable judge to automatically validate attack outcomes. Through DTap, we conduct large-scale evaluations of popular AI agents built on various backbone models, spanning security policies, risk categories, and attack strategies, revealing systematic vulnerability patterns and providing valuable insights for developing secure next-generation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap)，首个可控且可交互的AI智能体红队测试平台，覆盖14个真实领域和50+模拟环境；同时提出了DTap-Red自主红队测试智能体和DTap-Bench大规模红队测试数据集，系统评估了主流AI智能体的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在动态、不可信环境中运行，面临严重的安全风险，但缺乏可扩展、可控、可复现的大规模风险评估平台。
AI.method: 构建DTap平台（14个领域、50+模拟环境），提出DTap-Red自主红队测试智能体（探索多种注入向量），以及DTap-Bench大规模红队测试数据集（含可验证评判器）。
AI.result: 对主流AI智能体进行了大规模安全评估，揭示了系统性漏洞模式。
AI.conclusion: DTap为智能体安全评估提供了可控、可交互的标准化平台，为开发安全的下一代智能体提供了重要见解。

title: RLearner-LLM: Balancing Logical Grounding and Fluency in Large Language Models via Hybrid Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), the efficient alternative to PPO-based RLHF, falls short on knowledge-intensive generation: standard preference signals from human annotators or LLM judges exhibit a systematic verbosity bias that rewards fluency over logical correctness. This blindspot leaves a logical alignment gap -- SFT models reach NLI entailment of only 0.05-0.22 despite producing fluent text. We propose RLearner-LLM with Hybrid-DPO: an automated preference pipeline that fuses a DeBERTa-v3 NLI signal with a verifier LLM score, removing human annotation while overcoming the "alignment tax" of single-signal optimization. Evaluated across five academic domains (Biology, Medicine, Law) with three base architectures (LLaMA-2-13B, Qwen3-8B, Gemma 4 E4B-it), RLearner-LLM yields up to 6x NLI improvement over SFT, with NLI gains in 11 of 15 cells and consistent answer-coverage gains. On Gemma 4 E4B-it (4.5B effective params), Hybrid-DPO lifts NLI in four of five domains (+11.9% to +2.4x) with faster inference across all five, scaling down to compact base models without losing the alignment-tax mitigation. Our Qwen3-8B RLearner-LLM wins 95% of pairwise comparisons against its own SFT baseline; GPT-4o-mini in turn wins 95% against our concise output -- alongside the 69% win the same judge gives a verbose SFT over our DPO model, this replicates verbosity bias on a frontier comparator and motivates logic-aware metrics (NLI, ACR) over LLM-as-a-judge for knowledge-intensive generation.

AI.tldr: 提出RLearner-LLM与Hybrid-DPO方法，融合DeBERTa-v3 NLI信号和验证器LLM分数，在知识密集型生成任务中显著提升逻辑正确性（NLI提升最高6倍），同时避免单信号优化的对齐税问题。
AI.motivation: DPO在知识密集型生成中存在"逻辑对齐鸿沟"：标准偏好信号（人工或LLM评审）存在系统性冗长偏差，奖励流畅性而非逻辑正确性，导致SFT模型即使生成流畅文本，NLI蕴含率也仅0.05-0.22。
AI.method: 提出RLearner-LLM与Hybrid-DPO自动化偏好管道：融合DeBERTa-v3 NLI信号与验证器LLM评分，消除人工标注，克服单信号优化的对齐税。在5个学术领域（生物、医学、法律）、3种架构（LLaMA-2-13B, Qwen3-8B, Gemma 4 E4B-it）上评估。
AI.result: 相比SFT，NLI提升最高6倍，15个细胞中11个有NLI增益，且答案覆盖率一致提升。Gemma 4 E4B-it上4/5领域NLI提升（+11.9%至+2.4x），推理速度全面加快。Qwen3-8B模型95%胜率击败自身SFT基线。同时验证了GPT-4o-mini也存在冗长偏差。
AI.conclusion: Hybrid-DPO有效缓解DPO在知识密集型生成中的逻辑对齐问题，可扩展至紧凑基础模型而不损失对齐税缓解效果。建议在知识密集型生成中使用NLI、ACR等逻辑感知指标替代LLM-as-a-judge评估。

title: A cross-modal network for facial expression recognition
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing 2026
summary: Deep neural networks enriched with structural information have been widely employed for facial expression recognition tasks. However, these methods often depend on hierarchical information rather than face property to finish expression recognition. In this paper, we propose a cross-modal network with strong biological and structural information for facial expression recognition (CMNet). CMNet can respectively learn expression information via face symmetry on a whole face, left and right half faces to extract complementary facial features. To prevent negative effect of biological and structural information fusion, a salient facial information refinement module can obtain salient facial expression information to improve stability of an obtained facial expression classifier. To reduce reliance on unilateral facial features, a half-face alignment optimization mechanism is designed to align obtained expression information of learned left and right half faces. Our experimental results demonstrate that CMNet outperforms several novel methods, i.e., SCN and LAENet-SA for facial expression recognition. Codes can be obtained at https://github.com/hellloxiaotian/CMNet.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为CMNet的跨模态网络，利用人脸对称性和左右半脸提取互补表情特征，通过显著性表情信息精炼模块和半脸对齐优化机制提升表情识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于结构信息的深度神经网络多依赖层次信息而非人脸属性进行表情识别，缺乏对生物和结构信息的有效利用。
AI.method: 1) 利用人脸对称性从全脸、左半脸和右半脸分别学习表情信息；2) 提出显著性面部信息精炼模块避免生物与结构信息融合的负面影响；3) 设计半脸对齐优化机制减少对单侧人脸特征的依赖。
AI.result: 在面部表情识别任务上，CMNet优于SCN和LAENet-SA等最新方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合生物和结构信息的跨模态学习方法能有效提升面部表情识别的准确性和稳定性。

title: Strat-Reasoner: Reinforcing Strategic Reasoning of LLMs in Multi-Agent Games
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in certain reasoning tasks, they struggle in multi-agent games where the final outcome depends on the joint strategies of all agents. In multi-agent games, the non-stationarity of other agents brings significant challenges on the evaluation of the reasoning process and the credit assignment over multiple reasoning steps. Existing single-agent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches and their multi-agent extensions fail to address these challenges as they do not incorporate other agents in the reasoning process. In this work, we propose Strat-Reasoner, a novel RL-based framework that improves LLMs' strategic reasoning ability in multi-agent games. We introduce a novel recursive reasoning paradigm where an agent's reasoning also integrates other agents' reasoning processes. To provide effective reward signals for the intermediate reasoning sequences, we employ a centralized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) comparison module to evaluate the reasoning quality. Finally, we compute an accurate hybrid advantage and develop a group-relative RL approach to optimize the LLM policy. Experimental results show that Strat-Reasoner substantially improves strategic abilities of underlying LLMs, achieving 22.1\% average performance improvements across various multi-agent games.

AI.tldr: 提出Strat-Reasoner框架，通过递归推理、中心化CoT比较模块和混合优势的组相对强化学习，提升LLM在多智能体游戏中的策略推理能力，平均性能提升22.1%。
AI.motivation: LLM在多智能体游戏中表现不佳，因为其他智能体的非平稳性导致推理过程评估困难和信用分配问题，现有单智能体RL及其多智能体扩展未能将其他智能体纳入推理过程。
AI.method: 提出递归推理范式（智能体推理时整合其他智能体的推理过程）；中心化CoT比较模块评估中间推理质量；计算混合优势并采用组相对RL优化LLM策略。
AI.result: Strat-Reasoner显著提升底层LLM的策略能力，在多种多智能体游戏上平均性能提升22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该RL框架有效解决了多智能体游戏中LLM策略推理的挑战，为提升LLM在多智能体场景下的表现提供了新思路。

title: UniVer: A Unified Perspective for Multi-step and Multi-draft Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Models via draft-then-verify, where verification can be framed as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem. Existing approaches typically handle multi-draft and multi-step aspects in isolation, applying either flat OT to single-step drafts or per-token rejection sampling to tree-structured candidates. This separation leaves the joint regime (where multi-step dependencies meet multi-draft branching) poorly optimized, as local verification rules fail to exploit the coupling between horizontal and vertical dimensions of candidate trees. In this paper, we propose a unified perspective that casts tree-based verification as a conditional OT problem. Our key insight is that vertical dependencies can be abstracted through prefix acceptance probabilities, which act as dynamic scaling factors to actively guide horizontal draft selection. Based on this principle, we introduce UniVer, a verification algorithm that jointly optimizes across tree levels by composing local optimal transport plans under prefix constraints. We prove that UniVer remains lossless and achieves the optimal acceptance rate under the proposed conditional framework. Extensive experiments across different tasks and models demonstrate that UniVer improves acceptance length by 4.2% to 8.5% over standard recursive rejection sampling without replacement, while maintaining exact distributional alignment with the target model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniVer，一种基于条件最优传输的统一验证算法，通过前缀接受概率桥接多步依赖与多分支草稿，在树结构验证中实现无损且最优的接受率。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码验证方法将多草稿和多步验证孤立处理，未能联合优化树结构中水平分支与垂直依赖的耦合关系，导致局部验证规则效率低下。
AI.method: 将树结构验证建模为条件最优传输问题，利用前缀接受概率作为动态缩放因子引导草稿选择，通过在前缀约束下组合局部最优传输计划实现跨层级联合优化。
AI.result: 相比标准递归拒绝采样，UniVer在保持与目标模型精确分布对齐的同时，将接受长度提升4.2%至8.5%。
AI.conclusion: UniVer在条件最优传输框架下实现了无损且最优的树结构验证，有效提升了推测解码的效率。

title: LEGO: LoRA-Enabled Generator-Oriented Framework for Synthetic Image Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of generative technologies has made synthetic images nearly indistinguishable from real ones, thereby creating an urgent need for robust detectors to counter misinformation. However, existing methods mainly rely on universal artifact features that are shared across multiple generators. We observe that as the diversity of generators increases, the overlap of these common features gradually decreases. This severely undermines model generalization. In contrast, focusing only on unique artifacts tends to cause overfitting to specific forgery patterns. To address this challenge, we propose LEGO (LoRA-Enabled Generator-Oriented Framework). The core mechanism of LEGO employs an MLP to modulate multiple LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) blocks, each pretrained to capture the unique artifacts of a specific generator, followed by attention-based feature fusion. Unlike conventional methods that seek a single universal solution, LEGO delegates unique artifact extraction to specialized LoRA modules by dividing its training procedure into two stages. Each LoRA module is individually trained on a single-generator dataset to learn generator-specific representations, then MLP and attention layers are trained on mixed datasets to dynamically regulate the contribution of each module. Benefiting from its modular yet robust design, LEGO can be naturally extended by incorporating new LoRA modules for adaptation to newly emerging next-generation datasets, while still achieving substantially better performance than prior SOTA methods with fewer than 30,000 training images, less than 10% of their training data, and only 5 epochs in each training stage.

AI.tldr: 提出LEGO框架，通过LoRA模块捕获各生成器特有伪造痕迹，结合MLP调控与注意力融合，以极少训练数据实现超越现有方法的深度伪造检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法依赖跨生成器的通用伪影特征，但生成器多样化导致通用特征重叠减少，模型泛化性下降；若仅关注特有伪影又易过拟合。亟需一种能兼顾通用与特有特征的新方法。
AI.method: 提出LEGO框架：首先为每个生成器训练独立的LoRA模块以捕获其特有伪影；然后训练MLP动态调控各LoRA模块的贡献，并通过注意力机制进行特征融合。训练分两阶段，每阶段仅需5个epoch。
AI.result: 在少于30,000张训练图像（不到对比方法10%的数据量）、每阶段仅5个epoch的条件下，性能显著超越现有SOTA方法；且通过添加新LoRA模块可自然扩展至新一代生成器。
AI.conclusion: 模块化设计既能捕获生成器特有伪影避免过拟合，又能通过动态融合保持泛化性，且易于扩展，为深度伪造检测提供了高效实用的新范式。

title: The Newsworthiness of Brazilian Distress: A Peak Analysis on Time Series of International Media Attention to Disasters in Brazil
summary: Media coverage influences disaster response, yet the drivers of international media attention to local events remain unevenly understood. Brazil offers a compelling case: some of its natural and technological disasters occasionally hit the international headlines. However, systematic analyses of what makes these events be discussed abroad are still missing. Addressing this gap requires representative, validated and country-specific news datasets. This paper presents a peak analysis of 2k news about Brazilian fires and landslides in German newspapers from 2000 to 2024. Using time series segmentation to detect news event peaks, we examine the extent to which they can be temporally aligned with observations in national and global disaster databases.

AI.tldr: 分析2000-2024年德国报纸对巴西火灾和滑坡灾害的报道峰值，探究国际媒体关注巴西灾害的驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 国际媒体对地方灾害的关注度影响因素尚不明确，缺乏对巴西特定灾害的系统性分析。
AI.method: 对2000篇关于巴西火灾和滑坡的德国报纸新闻进行峰值分析，使用时间序列分割检测新闻事件峰值，并与国家和全球灾害数据库进行时间对齐。
AI.result: 尚未在摘要中明确给出具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究旨在填补对巴西灾害国际媒体关注度系统性分析的空白，提供代表性、验证性的国家特定新闻数据集。

title: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Logical Rule Induction
comment: Camera-ready version accepted at IJCAI 2026, with full appendices
summary: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) learns interpretable logical rules from data. Existing methods are transductive: their learned parameters are bound to specific predicates and require retraining for each new task. We introduce Neural Rule Inducer (NRI), a pretrained model for zero-shot rule induction. Rather than encoding literal identities, NRI represents literals using domain-agnostic statistical properties such as class-conditional rates, entropy, and co-occurrence, which generalize across variable identities and counts without retraining. The model consists of a statistical encoder and a parallel slot-based decoder. Parallel decoding preserves the permutation invariance of logical disjunction; an autoregressive decoder would instead impose an arbitrary clause order. Product T-norm relaxation makes rule execution differentiable, allowing end-to-end training on prediction accuracy alone. We evaluate NRI on rule recovery, robustness to label noise and spurious correlations, and zero-shot transfer to real-world benchmarks, and we believe this work opens up the possibility of foundation models for symbolic reasoning. Code and the reference checkpoint are available at https://github.com/phuayj/neural-rule-inducer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经规则归纳器（NRI），一种基于预训练的可零样本学习逻辑规则归纳的模型，通过统计特征表示文字而非具体谓词标识，结合并行槽解码与可微T-norm松弛，实现零样本迁移与符号推理。
AI.motivation: 现有归纳逻辑编程方法是传导式的，其学习参数绑定于特定谓词，每遇到新任务都需要重新训练，缺乏泛化能力。
AI.method: NRI使用统计编码器和并行槽解码器。将文字表示为领域无关的统计属性（如类条件概率、熵、共现频率）而非具体标识；并行解码保持逻辑析取的置换不变性；利用Product T-norm松弛使规则执行可微，实现端到端基于预测准确率的训练。
AI.result: 在规则恢复、对标签噪声和虚假相关性的鲁棒性、以及零样本迁移到真实世界基准任务上进行了评估，表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为符号推理的基础模型开辟了可能性。

title: RemoteZero: Geospatial Reasoning with Zero Human Annotations
summary: Geospatial reasoning requires models to resolve complex spatial semantics and user intent into precise target locations for Earth observation. Recent progress has liberated the reasoning path from manual curation, allowing models to generate their own inference chains. Yet a final dependency remains: they are still supervised by human-annotated ground-truth coordinates. This leaves the reasoning process autonomous, but not its spatial endpoint, and prevents true self-evolution on abundant unlabeled remote sensing data. To break this bottleneck, we introduce RemoteZero, a box-supervision-free framework for geospatial reasoning. RemoteZero is motivated by a simple asymmetry: an MLLM is typically better at verifying whether a region satisfies a query than at directly generating precise coordinates. Leveraging this stronger discriminative ability, RemoteZero replaces geometric supervision with intrinsic semantic verification and enables GRPO training without box annotations. The resulting framework further supports iterative self-evolution, allowing the model to improve from unlabeled remote sensing imagery through its own verification signal. Experiments show that RemoteZero achieves competitive performance against strong supervised methods, demonstrating the potential of self-verifying training for geospatial reasoning localization.

AI.tldr: RemoteZero提出了一种无需边界框监督的地理空间推理框架，利用MLLM更强的语义验证能力替代几何坐标监督，实现GRPO训练和自监督进化，在无标注遥感数据上取得与强监督方法竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间推理方法虽实现了推理路径的自动化，但仍依赖人工标注的地面真值坐标作为最终监督信号，无法在大量无标注遥感数据上实现真正的自我进化。作者希望打破这一瓶颈，消除对几何监督的依赖。
AI.method: RemoteZero利用多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在验证区域是否满足查询条件方面优于直接生成精确坐标这一不对称性，用内在语义验证替代几何监督，实现无边界框标注的GRPO训练，并支持在无标注遥感图像上通过模型自身的验证信号进行迭代自我进化。
AI.result: 在实验上，RemoteZero达到了与强监督方法相竞争的性能，验证了自验证训练在地理空间推理定位中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: RemoteZero证明了无需标注盒子的自验证训练框架可以有效替代传统几何监督，为地理空间推理的自我进化开辟了道路。

title: On-line Learning in Tree MDPs by Treating Policies as Bandit Arms
comment: Accepted as a full paper in the Main Track of AAMAS 2026
summary: A Tree Markov Decision Problem (T-MDP) is a finite-horizon MDP with a starting state $s_{1}$, in which every state is reachable from $s_{1}$ through exactly one state-action trajectory. T-MDPs arise naturally as abstractions of decision making in sequential games with perfect recall, against stationary opponents. We consider the problem of on-line learning in T-MDPs, both in the PAC and the regret-minimisation regimes. We show that well-known bandit algorithms -- \textsc{Lucb} and \textsc{Ucb} -- can be applied on T-MDPs by treating each policy as an arm. The apparent technical challenge in this approach is that the number of policies is exponential in the number of states. Our main innovation is in the design of confidence bounds based on data shared by the policies, so that the bandit algorithms can yet be implemented with polynomial memory and per-step computation. We obtain instance-dependent upper bounds on sample complexity and regret that sum a ``gap term'' from every terminal state, rather than every policy. Empirically, our algorithms consistently outperform available alternatives on a suite of hidden-information games.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在树形马尔可夫决策过程（T-MDP）中进行在线学习的方法，通过将每个策略视为一个臂并设计基于数据共享的置信界，使得经典的bandit算法（如LUCB和UCB）能够以多项式复杂度的存储和计算实现，并在样本复杂度和遗憾上取得了优于现有替代方案的性能。
AI.motivation: T-MDP自然产生于序列游戏中对抗固定对手的决策抽象，现有的在线学习方法面临策略数量随状态数指数增长的技术挑战，需要更高效的算法。
AI.method: 将每个策略视为一个臂，应用LUCB和UCB等bandit算法；核心创新在于设计基于策略间共享数据的置信界，使得算法可以在多项式内存和每步计算下实现，避免了直接枚举指数级策略的复杂度。
AI.result: 获得了依赖实例的上界：样本复杂度和遗憾仅与每个终端状态的"gap项"之和相关，而非每个策略；实验上，在一系列隐藏信息游戏中始终优于现有替代方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据共享的置信界设计，成功将bandit算法应用于T-MDP，实现了高效在线学习，并理论保证了性能上界。

title: StableI2I: Spotting Unintended Changes in Image-to-Image Transition
summary: In most real-world image-to-image (I2I) scenarios, existing evaluations primarily focus on instruction following and the perceptual quality or aesthetics of the generated images. However, they largely fail to assess whether the output image preserves the semantic correspondence and spatial structure of the input image. To address this limitation, we propose StableI2I, a unified and dynamic evaluation framework that explicitly measures content fidelity and pre--post consistency across a wide range of I2I tasks without requiring reference images, including image editing and image restoration. In addition, we construct StableI2I-Bench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the accuracy of MLLMs on such fidelity and consistency assessment tasks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that StableI2I provides accurate, fine-grained, and interpretable evaluations of content fidelity and consistency, with strong correlations to human subjective judgments. Our framework serves as a practical and reliable evaluation tool for diagnosing content consistency and benchmarking model performance in real-world I2I systems.

AI.tldr: 提出StableI2I，一个无需参考图像的统一评估框架，用于衡量图像到图像任务中的内容保真度和前后一致性，并构建了StableI2I-Bench基准来评估多模态大模型在这类任务上的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有I2I评估主要关注指令遵循和生成图像的感知质量/美学，但忽略了输出图像是否保留输入图像的语义对应关系和空间结构。
AI.method: 提出了StableI2I，一个统一且动态的评估框架，无需参考图像即可显式测量内容保真度和前后一致性；同时构建了StableI2I-Bench基准测试。
AI.result: 实验表明StableI2I能够提供准确、细粒度且可解释的内容保真度和一致性评估，与人类主观判断高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为实际I2I系统中诊断内容一致性和评估模型性能的实用、可靠工具。

title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation
summary: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems typically rely on rigid orchestration, committing either to flat per-query routing or to hand-engineered task decomposition, so decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget are not jointly optimized under one objective. We introduce Uno-Orchestra, a unified orchestration policy that selectively decomposes a task and dispatches each subtask to an admissible (model, primitive) pair, with both decisions learned together from curated RL trajectories grounded in real worker interactions. Against 22 baselines on a 13-benchmark suite spanning math, code, knowledge, long-context, and agentic tool-use, Uno-Orchestra reaches 77.0% macro pass@1, roughly 16% above the strongest workflow baseline, at roughly an order of magnitude lower per-query cost, advancing the accuracy-efficiency frontier of selective delegation.

AI.tldr: 提出Uno-Orchestra统一编排策略，通过强化学习联合优化任务分解与子任务分配，在13个基准测试上以低一个数量级的成本达到77.0%准确率，比最强工作流基线高约16%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统依赖刚性编排（平坦路由或手工任务分解），导致分解深度、工作节点选择和推理预算无法在统一目标下联合优化。
AI.method: Uno-Orchestra采用统一的编排策略，基于真实交互的强化学习轨迹联合学习任务选择性分解和子任务向（模型，原语）对的分配决策。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学、代码、知识、长上下文和工具使用的13基准套件上，对比22个基线，Uno-Orchestra达到77.0%宏观pass@1，比最强工作流基线高约16%，且每次查询成本低约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Uno-Orchestra推动了选择性委托的准确率-效率前沿，证明联合优化分解与分配可显著提升LLM多智能体系统的性能与成本效益。

title: Gradients with Respect to Semantics Preserving Embeddings Tell the Uncertainty of Large Language Models
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is an important technique for ensuring the trustworthiness of LLMs, given their tendency to hallucinate. Existing state-of-the-art UQ approaches for free-form generation rely heavily on sampling, which incurs high computational cost and variance. In this work, we propose the first gradient-based UQ method for free-form generation, SemGrad, which is sampling-free and computationally efficient. Unlike prior gradient-based methods developed for classification tasks that operates in parameter space, we propose to consider gradients in semantic space. Our method builds on the key intuition that a confident LLM should maintain stable output distributions under semantically equivalent input perturbations. We interpret the stability as the gradients in semantic space and introduce a Semantic Preservation Score (SPS) to identify embeddings that best capture semantics, with respect to which gradients are computed. We further propose HybridGrad, which combines the strengths of SemGrad and parameter gradients. Experiments demonstrate that both of our methods provide efficient and effective uncertainty estimates, achieving superior performance than state-of-the-art methods, particularly in settings with multiple valid responses.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于梯度的无采样不确定性量化方法SemGrad，通过语义空间梯度评估LLM输出稳定性，并融合参数梯度的HybridGrad方法，在自由文本生成中实现高效且优于现有方法的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 现有UQ方法依赖采样，计算成本高且方差大，亟需计算高效的梯度方法；同时分类任务的参数梯度方法不适用于自由文本生成。
AI.method: 提出SemGrad：在语义空间计算梯度，通过语义等价扰动下输出分布的稳定性衡量不确定性；引入语义保留分数(SPS)选择关键嵌入；进一步提出HybridGrad融合语义梯度与参数梯度。
AI.result: 实验表明SemGrad和HybridGrad均高效且有效，尤其在多有效响应场景下，性能优于现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义空间梯度是自由文本生成UQ的有效方向，无需采样即可获得高质量不确定性估计，具有计算优势。

title: Stream-T1: Test-Time Scaling for Streaming Video Generation
summary: While Test-Time Scaling (TTS) offers a promising direction to enhance video generation without the surging costs of training, current test-time video generation methods based on diffusion models suffer from exorbitant candidate exploration costs and lack temporal guidance. To address these structural bottlenecks, we propose shifting the focus to streaming video generation. We identify that its chunk-level synthesis and few denoising steps are intrinsically suited for TTS, significantly lowering computational overhead while enabling fine-grained temporal control. Driven by this insight, we introduced Stream-T1, a pioneering comprehensive TTS framework exclusively tailored for streaming video generation. Specifically, Stream-T1 is composed of three units: (1) Stream -Scaled Noise Propagation, which actively refines the initial latent noise of the generating chunk using historically proven, high-quality previous chunk noise, effectively establishes temporal dependency and utilizing the historical Gaussian prior to guide the current generation; (2) Stream -Scaled Reward Pruning, which comprehensively evaluates generated candidates to strike an optimal balance between local spatial aesthetics and global temporal coherence by integrating immediate short-term assessments with sliding-window-based long-term evaluations; (3) Stream-Scaled Memory Sinking, which dynamically routes the context evicted from KV-cache into distinct updating pathways guided by the reward feedback, ensuring that previously generated visual information effectively anchors and guides the subsequent video stream. Evaluated on both 5s and 30s comprehensive video benchmarks, Stream-T1 demonstrates profound superiority, significantly improving temporal consistency, motion smoothness, and frame-level visual quality.

AI.tldr: Stream-T1是一个专为流式视频生成设计的测试时扩展框架，通过噪声传播、奖励剪枝和记忆下沉三个单元，在降低计算成本的同时显著提升视频的时间一致性、运动平滑度和帧级视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的测试时视频生成方法存在候选探索成本过高和缺乏时间引导的结构性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Stream-T1框架，包含三个核心单元：(1) Stream-Scaled Noise Propagation利用历史高质量噪声引导当前生成；(2) Stream-Scaled Reward Pruning结合短期与滑动窗口长期评估平衡局部美学与全局时序；(3) Stream-Scaled Memory Sinking通过奖励反馈动态路由KV-cache上下文。
AI.result: 在5秒和30秒视频基准测试中，Stream-T1在时间一致性、运动平滑度和帧级视觉质量上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将TTS从扩散模型转向流式视频生成能有效解决计算开销和时序控制难题，Stream-T1验证了这一方向的有效性。

title: Position: Embodied AI Requires a Privacy-Utility Trade-off
summary: Embodied AI (EAI) systems are rapidly transitioning from simulations into real-world domestic and other sensitive environments. However, recent EAI solutions have largely demonstrated advancements within isolated stages such as instruction, perception, planning and interaction, without considering their coupled privacy implications in high-frequency deployments where privacy leakage is often irreversible. This position paper argues that optimizing these components independently creates a systemic privacy crisis when deployed in sensitive settings, thereby advancing the position that privacy in EAI is a life cycle-level architectural constraint rather than a stage-local feature. To address these challenges, we propose Secure Privacy Integration in Next-generation Embodied AI (SPINE), a unified privacy-aware framework that treats privacy as a dynamic control signal governing cross-stage coupling throughout the entire EAI life cycle. SPINE decomposes the EAI pipeline into various stages and establishes a multi-criterion privacy classification matrix to orchestrate contextual sensitivity across stage boundaries. We conduct preliminary simulation and real-world case studies to conceptually validate how privacy constraints propagate downstream to reshape system behavior, illustrating the insufficiency of fragmented privacy patches and motivating future research directions into secure yet functional embodied AI systems. We detail the SPINE framework and case studies at https://github.com/rminshen03/EAI_Privacy_Position.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了具身AI（EAI）系统的隐私问题是一个全生命周期架构约束，而非阶段局部特征，并提出SPINE统一隐私感知框架，将隐私视为跨阶段耦合的动态控制信号。
AI.motivation: 现有EAI系统在指令、感知、规划、交互等独立阶段取得了进展，但忽略了高频部署中不可逆的隐私泄露风险。独立优化各组件会在敏感环境中引发系统性隐私危机。
AI.method: 提出SPINE框架，将EAI流水线分解为多个阶段，建立多准则隐私分类矩阵，跨阶段边界协调上下文敏感性，将隐私作为动态控制信号贯穿EAI全生命周期。
AI.result: 通过初步仿真和真实场景案例验证了隐私约束如何向下游传播并重塑系统行为，揭示了碎片化隐私补丁的不足。
AI.conclusion: 隐私应是EAI系统全生命周期的架构级约束，而非局部特征，SPINE框架为未来安全且功能完整的具身AI系统指明了研究方向。

title: Graph-Augmented LLMs for Swiss MP Ideology Prediction
summary: Approximating the ideological position of Members of Parliament (MPs) is a fundamental task in political science, helping researchers understand legislative behavior, party alignment, and policy preferences. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising results in estimating MPs' ideological stances, there are more actors and elements in the parliamentary system, and relations between them, that could provide a wider and more informative picture. However, due to the complexity of integrating them in the prediction task, these additional elements are generally ignored. In this work, we propose an LLM framework, PG-RAG, that implements a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline: it first queries a political knowledge graph (KG) and then integrates the resulting graph-structured information into the context. This allows for capturing both textual semantics and inter-MP relationships, another relevant information source in any parliamentary system. We evaluate the approach on the task of ideology prediction, using data from a Swiss parliamentary dataset. When comparing graph-augmented models against several state-of-the-art baselines, the results demonstrate that incorporating this enriched information, which encodes information about different entities and relations, improves prediction performance. These results help to highlight the value of domain-specific relational information in modeling political behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PG-RAG框架，结合知识图谱与大语言模型，通过检索增强生成方式整合议会实体关系信息，显著提升了议员意识形态预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM预测议员意识形态立场时仅关注文本语义，忽略了议会系统中更广泛的实体及其相互关系，而这些关系信息本可提供更全面的分析视角。
AI.method: 提出PG-RAG框架，采用检索增强生成流水线：先查询政治知识图谱，再将图谱结构信息集成到LLM上下文中，同时捕获文本语义和议员间关系信息。
AI.result: 在瑞士议会数据集上，图增强模型相比多个最先进基线方法，在意识形态预测任务上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 整合领域特定的关系信息（如不同实体及其关系）能够有效提升政治行为建模的性能，凸显了结构化关系信息在政治分析中的价值。

title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents
summary: We evaluate an initial coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 in which the agent maintains an executable Python world model, verifies it against previous observations, refactors it toward simpler abstractions as a practical proxy for an MDL-like simplicity bias, and plans through the model before acting. The system is intentionally direct: it uses a scripted controller, predefined world-model interfaces, verifier programs, and a plan executor, but no hand-coded game-specific logic. We report results on the 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games. Each recorded playthrough uses a fresh agent instance with no access to previous playthrough-specific files or conversation state. Most games have a single recorded playthrough; for a few games, we report multiple independent fresh-agent playthroughs to expose run-to-run variability. The agent fully solved 7 games, achieved a Relative Human Action Efficiency greater than 75%, on 6 games, and obtained a mean per-game RHAE of 32.58%. Because the system uses no game-specific code, it can serve as a game-general baseline for ARC-AGI-3. Performance on the private validation set remains to be tested. Overall, the results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-driven executable world models are a promising approach for ARC-AGI-3 agents.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一个针对ARC-AGI-3的初始编码代理系统，该系统维护可执行的Python世界模型，通过验证器验证观察结果，通过重构简化抽象（作为MDL式简单性偏好的代理），并在行动前进行规划。该系统在25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏中，完全解决了7个，平均每局RHAE为32.58%。结果表明，验证器驱动的可执行世界模型是一种有前景的方法。
AI.motivation: 探索一种无需游戏特定代码、基于可执行世界模型和验证驱动的通用方法来解决ARC-AGI-3任务，避免手工编码的特定逻辑，追求更通用的智能体。
AI.method: 采用脚本化控制器、预定义世界模型接口、验证器程序和计划执行器构建智能体。智能体维护Python世界模型，通过验证器比对新观察来修正模型，通过重构简化抽象（作为MDL最小描述长度原则的代理），然后在模型上规划再执行动作。
AI.result: 在25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏中，完全解决了7个游戏；6个游戏上RHAE（相对人类行动效率）超过75%；平均每局RHAE为32.58%。部分游戏进行了多次独立运行以展示变异性。
AI.conclusion: 验证器驱动的可执行世界模型是构建ARC-AGI-3智能体的有前景方法。由于未使用游戏特定代码，该系统可作为游戏通用的基线。私有验证集性能有待进一步测试。

title: CHE-TKG: Collaborative Historical Evidence and Evolutionary Dynamics Learning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) reasoning aims to predict future events from historical facts. A key challenge lies in jointly capturing two sources of predictive information in TKGs: historical evidence and evolutionary dynamics. However, existing methods typically focus on only one of these sources, which limits the ability to fully exploit the complementary predictive signals in TKGs. To address this, we propose CHE-TKG, a novel collaborative dual-view learning framework for TKG reasoning. CHE-TKG explicitly separates and jointly models historical evidence and evolutionary dynamics, aiming to learn and exploit their complementary predictive signals. Specifically, CHE-TKG constructs a historical evidence graph to capture long-term structural regularities and stable relational constraints, alongside an evolutionary dynamics graph to model temporal transitions and recent changes, with dedicated encoders for each view. We further employ relation decomposition and a contrastive alignment objective to better capture the predictive signals across the two views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CHE-TKG achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CHE-TKG提出了一种协同双视图学习框架，通过分别建模历史证据和演化动态来捕捉时序知识图谱中的互补预测信号，在多个基准上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TKG推理方法通常只关注历史证据或演化动态中的一种信息源，未能充分利用两者之间的互补预测信号，限制了推理性能。
AI.method: 提出CHE-TKG框架，构建历史证据图（捕捉长期结构规律）和演化动态图（建模时序变化），分别使用专用编码器；采用关系分解和对比对齐目标来融合双视图的预测信号。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离并联合建模历史证据与演化动态，能够有效利用二者的互补信息，显著提升TKG推理效果。

title: LongSeeker: Elastic Context Orchestration for Long-Horizon Search Agents
summary: Long-horizon search agents must manage a rapidly growing working context as they reason, call tools, and observe information. Naively accumulating all intermediate content can overwhelm the agent, increasing costs and the risk of errors. We propose that effective context management should be adaptive: parts of the agent's trajectory are maintained at different levels of detail depending on their current relevance to the task. To operationalize this principle, we introduce Context-ReAct, a general agentic paradigm for elastic context orchestration that integrates reasoning, context management, and tool use in a unified loop. Context-ReAct provides five atomic operations: Skip, Compress, Rollback, Snippet and Delete, which allow the agent to dynamically reshape its working context, preserving important evidence, summarizing resolved information, discarding unhelpful branches, and controlling context size. We prove that the Compress operator is expressively complete, while the other specialized operators provide efficiency and fidelity guarantees that reduce generation cost and hallucination risk. Building on this paradigm, we develop LongSeeker, a long-horizon search agent fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized trajectories. Across four representative search benchmarks, LongSeeker achieves 61.5% on BrowseComp and 62.5% on BrowseComp-ZH, substantially outperforming Tongyi DeepResearch (43.2% and 46.7%) and AgentFold (36.2% and 47.3%). These results highlight the potential of adaptive context management, showing that agents can achieve more reliable and efficient long-horizon reasoning by actively shaping their working memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Context-ReAct，一种弹性上下文编排的通用智能体范式，通过Skip、Compress、Rollback、Snippet和Delete五种原子操作动态管理工作上下文。基于此开发的LongSeeker智能体在长程搜索基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长程搜索智能体在推理、调用工具和观察信息时，工作上下文会快速增长，累积所有中间内容会导致成本增加和错误风险上升，现有方法缺乏自适应的上下文管理能力。
AI.method: 提出Context-ReAct范式，集成推理、上下文管理和工具使用于统一循环，提供五种原子操作（Skip、Compress、Rollback、Snippet、Delete）。证明Compress操作表达完备，其他操作提供效率和保真度保证。基于此微调Qwen3-30B-A3B得到LongSeeker智能体。
AI.result: LongSeeker在BrowseComp和BrowseComp-ZH上分别达到61.5%和62.5%，大幅超越Tongyi DeepResearch（43.2%、46.7%）和AgentFold（36.2%、47.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 自适应的上下文管理能使智能体通过主动塑造工作记忆，实现更可靠和高效的长程推理。

title: Paraphrase-Induced Output-Mode Collapse: When LLMs Break Character Under Semantically Equivalent Inputs
summary: When the substantive content of a request is rewritten, do large language models still answer in the format the original task asked for? We find that they often do not, even at temperature zero. On a 150-query evaluation over five compact 2025-era LLMs and four task types, we observe a systematic failure mode we call prompt-variant output-mode collapse: when a closed-form prompt asks for a bare label or a single choice token, content-preserving prompt variants can push the model into conversational prose, the requested format dissolves, and exact-match evaluation pipelines silently misjudge the result. To make this measurable, we release PARACONSIST, a 900-prompt benchmark of 150 base queries with five lexical, syntactic, and semantic-expansion prompt variants each, and a Semantic Consistency Score that decomposes prompt-variant robustness into answer consistency, sentence-BERT semantic similarity, and length stability. Under a whole-word answer-set match, only ~22% of closed-form variant responses preserve the ground-truth label inside their output, while ~78% drift away from the answer space entirely. In our pool, the dominant predictor of collapse is task structure rather than model identity, with model differentiation jointly carried by answer consistency and length stability. Robustness audits should therefore track response-mode preservation as a first-class reliability target alongside answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: LLM在面对内容保留但形式变化的提示时，会系统性偏离原任务要求的输出格式（如从封闭式标签变成散文式回答），导致评估失效。作者发布了PARACONSIST基准和语义一致性评分来衡量这一现象。
AI.motivation: 当提示的实质性内容被改写（保留语义但改变词汇、句法或扩展方式）时，大语言模型是否还能保持原始任务要求的输出格式？已有工作关注答案正确性，但忽略了输出格式的保持问题。
AI.method: 在5个2025-era LLM上，对150个查询设计5种变体（词汇、句法、语义扩展），共900个提示，提出PARACONSIST基准和语义一致性评分（包含答案一致性、句子BERT语义相似度、长度稳定性三个维度）。
AI.result: 在封闭式格式下，仅约22%的变体响应保留了真实标签在输出中，约78%完全偏离答案空间。任务结构是格式坍塌的主要预测因子，模型差异由答案一致性和长度稳定性共同体现。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性审查应将响应模式保持作为与答案准确性同等重要的可靠性目标。

title: DiffCap-Bench: A Comprehensive, Challenging, Robust Benchmark for Image Difference Captioning
summary: Image Difference Captioning (IDC) generates natural language descriptions that precisely identify differences between two images, serving as a key benchmark for fine-grained change perception, cross-modal reasoning, and image editing data construction. However, existing benchmarks lack diversity and compositional complexity, and standard lexical-overlap metrics (e.g., BLEU, METEOR) fail to capture semantic consistency or penalize hallucinations, which together prevent a comprehensive and robust evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on IDC. To address these gaps, we introduce DiffCap-Bench, a comprehensive IDC benchmark covering ten distinct difference categories to ensure diversity and compositional complexity. Furthermore, we propose an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation protocol grounded in human-validated Difference Lists, enabling a robust assessment of models' ability to both capture and describe visual changes. Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art MLLMs, we reveal significant performance gaps between proprietary and open-source models, highlight the critical importance of reasoning capability, and identify clear limitations in model scaling. Our framework also demonstrates strong alignment with human expert judgments and strong correlation with downstream image editing data construction quality. These findings establish DiffCap-Bench as both a reliable IDC evaluation framework and a practical predictor of downstream utility. The benchmark and code will be made publicly available to support further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffCap-Bench，一个涵盖10种差异类别的图像差异描述(IDC)基准，并采用基于LLM的评估协议，实现对多模态大模型在细粒度变化感知和跨模态推理方面的全面稳健评估。
AI.motivation: 现有IDC基准缺乏多样性和组合复杂性，且基于词重叠的评估指标（如BLEU、METEOR）无法捕捉语义一致性或惩罚幻觉，导致无法全面鲁棒地评估多模态大模型在IDC任务上的表现。
AI.method: 构建DiffCap-Bench，包含10个差异类别以确保多样性；提出基于人工验证的差异列表的LLM-as-a-Judge评估协议。
AI.result: 揭示了闭源与开源模型间的显著性能差距，强调了推理能力的关键作用，并指出了模型规模扩展的局限性；框架与人类专家判断高度一致，与下游图像编辑数据构建质量强相关。
AI.conclusion: DiffCap-Bench是可靠的IDC评估框架及下游应用性能的有效预测工具。

title: Every Step Counts: Step-Level Credit Assignment for Tool-Integrated Text-to-SQL
summary: Tool-integrated Text-to-SQL parsing has emerged as a promising paradigm, framing SQL generation as a sequential decision-making process interleaved with tool execution. However, existing reinforcement learning approaches mainly rely on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in a fundamental credit assignment problem: models receive the same reward for any trajectory that yields the correct answer, even when intermediate steps are redundant, inefficient, or erroneous. Consequently, models are encouraged to explore suboptimal reasoning spaces, limiting both efficiency and generalization. To address this problem, we propose FineStep, a novel framework for step-level credit assignment in tool-augmented Text-to-SQL. First, we introduce a reward design with independent process rewards to alleviate the signal sparsity of outcome supervision. Next, we present a step-level credit assignment mechanism to precisely quantify the value of each reasoning step. Finally, we develop a policy optimization method based on step-level advantages for efficient updates. Extensive experiments on BIRD benchmarks show that FineStep achieves state-of-the-art performance and reduces redundant tool interactions, with a 3.25% average EX gain over GRPO at the 4B scale.

AI.tldr: FineStep提出了一种步骤级信用分配框架，通过独立过程奖励和步骤级优势策略优化，解决了工具增强型Text-to-SQL中粗粒度结果监督导致的信用分配问题，在BIRD基准上达到SOTA性能，相比GRPO平均EX提升3.25%。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法主要依赖粗粒度的结果监督，导致信用分配问题：只要最终答案正确，中间步骤无论是否冗余、低效或错误都获得相同奖励，限制了模型的效率和泛化能力。
AI.method: FineStep框架包括三个部分：1）设计基于独立过程奖励的奖励机制以缓解结果监督的信号稀疏性；2）提出步骤级信用分配机制以精确量化每个推理步骤的价值；3）基于步骤级优势的策略优化方法实现高效更新。
AI.result: 在BIRD基准上的大量实验表明，FineStep达到了SOTA性能，减少了冗余工具交互，在4B规模下平均EX比GRPO提升3.25%。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级的精细信用分配能够有效提升工具增强型Text-to-SQL的性能和效率，为解决粗粒度监督带来的探索次优推理空间问题提供了可行方案。

title: SpecPL: Disentangling Spectral Granularity for Prompt Learning
summary: Existing prompt learning for VLMs exhibits a modality asymmetry, predominantly optimizing text tokens while still relying on frozen visual encoder as holistic extractor and neglecting the spectral granularity essential for fine-grained discrimination. To bridge this, we introduce Disentangling Spectral Granularity for Prompt Learning (SpecPL), which approaches prompt learning from a novel spectral perspective via Counterfactual Granule Supervision. Specifically, we leverage a frozen VAE to decompose visual signals into semantic low-frequency bands and granular high-frequency details. A frozen Visual Semantic Bank anchors text representations to universal low-frequency invariants, mitigating overfitting. Crucially, fine-grained discrimination is driven by counterfactual granule training: by permuting high-frequency signals, we compel the model to explicitly distinguish visual granularity from semantic invariance. Uniquely, SpecPL serves as a universal plug-and-play booster, revitalizing text-oriented baselines like CoOp and MaPLe via visual-side guidance. Experiments on 11 benchmarks demonstrate competitive state-of-the-art performance, achieving a new performance ceiling of 81.51\% harmonic-mean accuracy. These results validate that spectral disentanglement with counterfactual supervision effectively bridges the gap in the stability-generalization trade-off. Code is released at https://github.com/Mlrac1e/SpecPL-Prompt-Learning.

AI.tldr: SpecPL通过反事实粒度监督从频谱角度解耦视觉信号，将文本提示学习与视觉细粒度信息结合，在11个基准上达到81.51%的调和平均精度新高度。
AI.motivation: 现有提示学习存在模态不对称性——只优化文本token而冻结视觉编码器，忽略了细粒度判别所需的频谱粒度信息。
AI.method: 1）利用冻结VAE将视觉信号分解为语义低频波段和细粒度高频细节；2）冻结视觉语义库将文本表示锚定到通用低频不变量；3）通过置换高频信号进行反事实粒度训练，迫使模型区分视觉粒度与语义不变性。
AI.result: 在11个基准上达到81.51%调和平均精度，超越现有方法，可作为即插即用模块提升CoOp、MaPLe等基线。
AI.conclusion: 频谱解耦结合反事实监督有效弥合了稳定性-泛化权衡的差距，验证了视觉侧引导对文本提示学习的提升作用。

title: Gyan: An Explainable Neuro-Symbolic Language Model
summary: Transformer based pre-trained large language models have become ubiquitous. There is increasing evidence to suggest that even with large scale pre-training, these models do not capture complete compositional context and certainly not, the full human analogous context. Besides, by the very nature of the architecture, these models hallucinate, are difficult to maintain, are not easily interpretable and require enormous compute resources for training and inference. Here, we describe Gyan, an explainable language model based on a novel non-transformer architecture, without any of these limitations. Gyan achieves SOTA performance on 3 widely cited data sets and superior performance on two proprietary data sets. The novel architecture decouples the language model from knowledge acquisition and representation. The model draws on rhetorical structure theory, semantic role theory and knowledge-based computational linguistics. Gyan's meaning representation structure captures the complete compositional context and attempts to mimic humans by expanding the context to a 'world model'. AI model adoption critically depends on trust and transparency especially in mission critical use cases. Collectively, our results demonstrate that it is possible to create models which are trustable and reliable for mission critical tasks. We believe our work has tremendous potential for guiding the development of transparent and trusted architectures for language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Gyan的新型非Transformer架构语言模型，该模型可解释、不产生幻觉、易于维护，通过解耦语言模型与知识获取，结合修辞结构理论、语义角色理论和知识计算语言学，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，为构建可信赖的NLP模型提供了新方向。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的预训练大语言模型存在无法捕捉完整组合上下文、产生幻觉、难以维护、不可解释且需要巨大计算资源等问题，亟需一种更可信、更透明的语言模型架构。
AI.method: 提出非Transformer架构Gyan，将语言模型与知识获取表征解耦，融合修辞结构理论、语义角色理论和知识计算语言学，构建能够捕捉完整组合上下文的语义表示结构，并扩展至"世界模型"。
AI.result: 在3个广泛引用的公开数据集上达到SOTA性能，在2个专有数据集上表现更优，同时具备可解释性、无幻觉、易维护等特性。
AI.conclusion: 证明了可以构建用于关键任务的可信赖、可靠的语言模型，为透明可信的NLP架构提供了新的发展路径。

title: Ilov3Splat: Instance-Level Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Gaussian Splatting
comment: The International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) 2026
summary: We introduce Ilov3Splat, a novel framework for instance-level open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding built on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS). Most prior work depends on 2D rendering-based matching or point-level semantic association, which undermines cross-view consistency, lacks coherent instance-level reasoning, and limits precision in downstream 3D tasks. To address these limitations, our method jointly optimizes scene geometry and semantic representations by augmenting Gaussian splats with view-consistent feature fields. Specifically, we leverage multi-resolution hash embedding to efficiently encode language-aligned CLIP features, enabling dense and coherent language grounding in 3D space. We further train an instance feature field using contrastive loss over SAM masks, supporting fine-grained object distinction across views. At inference time, CLIP-encoded queries are matched against the learned features, followed by two-stage 3D clustering to retrieve relevant Gaussian groups. This enables our framework to identify arbitrary objects in 3D scenes based on natural language descriptions, without requiring category supervision or manual annotations. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that Ilov3Splat outperforms prior open-vocabulary 3D-GS methods in both object selection and instance segmentation, offering a flexible and accurate solution for language-driven 3D scene understanding. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/Ilov3Splat.

AI.tldr: Ilov3Splat 是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的实例级开放词汇3D场景理解框架，通过多分辨率哈希嵌入和对比学习实现语言驱动的3D物体识别与分割。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖2D渲染匹配或点级语义关联，存在跨视角不一致、缺乏实例级推理、下游任务精度受限等问题。
AI.method: 1) 用多分辨率哈希嵌入编码CLIP特征，增强高斯溅射的语义表示；2) 基于SAM掩码的对比学习训练实例特征场；3) 推理时用CLIP查询匹配特征，经两阶段3D聚类检索相关高斯组。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，Ilov3Splat在物体选择和实例分割任务中均优于现有开放词汇3D-GS方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需类别监督或人工标注，即可基于自然语言灵活准确地理解3D场景中的任意物体。

title: Elicitation Matters: How Prompts and Query Protocols Shape LLM Surrogates under Sparse Observations
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as surrogate models for low-data optimization, but their optimizer-facing prediction and its uncertainty remain poorly understood. We study the surrogate belief elicited from an LLM under sparse observations, showing that it depends strongly on prompt text and query protocol. We introduce an uncertainty-alignment criterion that measures whether model uncertainty tracks residual ambiguity among sample-consistent functions. Across controlled inference tasks and Bayesian optimization studies, we find that structural prompts act as effective priors, POINTWISE and JOINT querying induce different beliefs, and sequential evidence leads to non-monotonic, order-sensitive confidence updates. These effects change downstream acquisition decisions and regret, showing that elicitation protocol is part of the LLM surrogate specification, not a formatting detail.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM作为替代模型时，其预测和不确定性高度依赖于提示文本和查询协议，且存在非单调、顺序敏感的置信更新现象。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多用作低数据优化中的替代模型，但其面向优化器的预测及不确定性机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出了不确定性与一致性对齐准则，通过控制推理任务和贝叶斯优化实验，比较结构提示、逐点/联合查询协议及顺序证据对模型信念的影响。
AI.result: 结构提示可作为有效先验；逐点查询和联合查询诱发不同信念；顺序证据导致非单调、顺序敏感的置信更新。
AI.conclusion: 引出协议是LLM替代模型规范的一部分，而非格式细节，会显著影响下游采集决策和遗憾值。

title: From Priors to Perception: Grounding Video-LLMs in Physical Reality
summary: While Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) excel in general understanding, they exhibit systematic deficits in fine-grained physical reasoning. Existing interventions not only suffer from limited generalization but fundamentally conflate generative artifacts with genuine physical fallacies. Furthermore, we find that models fail systematically not only in anti-physics anomalies but also in counter-intuitive scenarios where visual facts contradict statistical expectations. Accordingly, we propose the Unified Attribution Theory: this dual failure stems not from perception deficiency, but from Semantic Prior Dominance -- the reasoning mechanism is deeply hijacked by internal narrative scripts. To address this, we construct the Programmatic Adversarial Curriculum (PACC), the first high-fidelity adversarial video dataset synthesized based on physical laws, thoroughly decoupling visual artifacts from logical errors. Concurrently, we design the Visual-Anchored Reasoning Chain (VARC) to force models to explicitly ground their judgments in low-level visual facts prior to logical adjudication. Experiments demonstrate that without invasive architectural modifications, standard LoRA fine-tuning with the PACC curriculum effectively neutralizes prior interference in state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, yielding a substantial leap in physical reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Video-LLMs在物理推理中存在系统性缺陷，根源并非感知不足，而是语义先验主导（Semantic Prior Dominance）——模型推理被内部叙事脚本劫持。为此，作者提出基于物理定律合成的对抗性视频数据集PACC，以及强制模型基于低级视觉事实进行推理的VARC方法，通过LoRA微调即可显著提升物理推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有Video-LLMs在细粒度物理推理中存在系统性缺陷，且已有干预方法泛化能力有限，混淆了生成伪影与真实物理谬误。此外，模型不仅在反物理异常场景中失败，在视觉事实与统计预期相悖的反直觉场景中也同样失败，亟需统一的理论解释和有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出统一归因理论（Unified Attribution Theory），将双重失败归因于语义先导主导（Semantic Prior Dominance）。构建基于物理定律合成的对抗性视频数据集PACC（Programmatic Adversarial Curriculum），彻底解耦视觉伪影与逻辑错误。设计视觉锚定推理链VARC（Visual-Anchored Reasoning Chain），强制模型在进行逻辑判断前，先明确基于低级视觉事实进行推理。采用标准LoRA微调进行干预。
AI.result: 无需侵入式架构修改，仅通过标准LoRA微调配合PACC课程，即可有效中和SOTA模型中的语义先验干扰，物理推理能力获得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: Video-LLMs物理推理失败的根源是语义先验主导而非感知缺陷，通过对抗性物理数据集训练和视觉锚定推理链可有效解决该问题。

title: StoryAlign: Evaluating and Training Reward Models for Story Generation
summary: Story generation aims to automatically produce coherent, structured, and engaging narratives. Although large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced text generation, stories generated by LLMs still diverge from human-authored works regarding complex narrative structure and human-aligned preferences. A key reason is the absence of effective modeling of human story preferences, which are inherently subjective and under-explored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the modeling of human story preferences and introduce StoryRMB, the first benchmark for assessing reward models on story preferences. StoryRMB contains $1,133$ high-quality, human-verified instances, each consisting of a prompt, one chosen story, and three rejected stories. We find existing reward models struggle to select human-preferred stories, with the best model achieving only $66.3\%$ accuracy. To address this limitation, we construct roughly $100,000$ high-quality story preference pairs across diverse domains and develop StoryReward, an advanced reward model for story preference trained on this dataset. StoryReward achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance on StoryRMB, outperforming much larger models. We also adopt StoryReward in downstream test-time scaling applications for best-of-n (BoN) story selection and find that it generally chooses stories better aligned with human preferences. We will release our dataset, model, and code to facilitate future research. Related code and data are available at https://github.com/THU-KEG/StoryReward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StoryRMB，首个评估故事偏好奖励模型的基准，并开发了StoryReward模型，在故事偏好选择上达到SOTA性能（66.3%准确率），显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型生成的故事在叙事结构和人类偏好对齐方面与人类创作存在差距，根本原因在于缺乏对主观且未被充分探索的人类故事偏好的有效建模。
AI.method: 提出了StoryRMB基准（含1,133个高质量人工验证实例），并构建了约10万个高质量故事偏好对数据集，训练了StoryReward奖励模型。
AI.result: 最佳现有模型仅达66.3%准确率；StoryReward在StoryRMB上达到SOTA，优于更大规模的模型，并在下游BoN故事选择中表现更符合人类偏好。
AI.conclusion: StoryReward有效建模了人类故事偏好，提升了故事生成与人类偏好的对齐程度，数据集和代码已开源。

title: Assessing Cognitive Effort in L2 Idiomatic Processing: An Eye-Tracking Dataset
summary: This paper presents the development and validation of an eye-tracking dataset designed to investigate how second-language (L2) learners process idiomatic expressions. While native speakers often rely on direct retrieval of figurative meanings, L2 speakers frequently adopt a literal-first approach, which incurs measurable cognitive costs. This resource captures these costs through ocular metrics recorded from Portuguese L1 speakers of English across all CEFR proficiency levels (A1-C2). Although the study uses entry-level 60 Hz hardware (Tobii Pro Spark), we demonstrate that this sampling rate provides sufficient data density to detect macro-cognitive events such as fixations and regressions in reading. Preliminary analysis validates the dataset by revealing a strong inverse correlation between language proficiency and regressive eye movements. Integrated into the MIA (Modeling Idiomaticity in Human and Artificial Language Processing) initiative, this dataset serves as a cognitively grounded benchmark for evaluating both human processing models and the alignment of large language models with human-like figurative understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并验证了一个眼动追踪数据集，用于研究二语学习者如何处理习语表达，发现语言水平与回视性眼动呈强负相关，并为人类和人工智能语言模型提供了认知基准。
AI.motivation: 二语学习者在处理习语时往往采用"字面义优先"策略，产生可测量的认知成本。目前缺乏跨语言水平、基于眼动追踪的标准化数据集来量化这一过程。
AI.method: 使用60 Hz Tobii Pro Spark眼动仪，采集葡萄牙语母语者（英语为二语）从A1到C2各CEFR水平的眼动数据，分析注视和回视等宏观认知事件。
AI.result: 初步分析验证了数据集的有效性：语言水平与回视性眼动之间存在强负相关关系，表明60 Hz采样率足以检测阅读中的宏观认知事件。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为评估人类处理模型以及大语言模型在习语理解上与人类对齐程度提供了认知基准，已整合至MIA计划中。

title: High-Fidelity Single-Image Head Modeling with Industry-Grade Topology
summary: We present a single-image head mesh reconstruction framework that addresses the longstanding challenge of simultaneously preserving facial identity and producing industry-grade topology. Our framework adopts a coarse-to-fine optimization pipeline that refines a rigged template across three stages -- rig, joint, and vertex -- achieving stable convergence and consistent topology. To mitigate the ill-posed nature of single-image 3D face reconstruction and ensure identity preservation, we employ a normal consistency objective jointly with landmark alignment. To further preserve local surface structure and enforce topological regularity, we introduce geometry-aware constraints based on Gaussian curvature and conformal consistency, along with auxiliary regularizations that correct fine artifacts such as lip seams and eyelid discontinuities. Our hierarchical optimization with geometry-aware regularization yields meshes with semantically meaningful edge flow and industry-grade topology. After geometry reconstruction, we extract UV-space texture and normal maps to preserve appearance details for visualization and downstream use. In a user study with 22 professional technical artists, our results were assessed as approaching industry-grade usability, and 95% of participants ranked our method as the top-performing approach, underscoring its effectiveness for real-world digital human production.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从单张图像重建高质量头部网格的框架，采用由粗到细的三阶段优化管线（骨架、关节、顶点），结合几何感知约束（高斯曲率、共形一致性）和法向一致性目标，生成具有工业级拓扑和语义化边流的网格。用户研究中22位专业艺术家中95%将其评为最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 单张图像的人脸3D重建长期面临两大挑战：保真面部身份与生成工业级拓扑难以兼得。现有方法要么拓扑不规则难以直接用于生产管线，要么在身份保留上存在缺陷。
AI.method: 采用粗到细的优化管线，分三个阶段（rig、joint、vertex）对带绑定的模板网格进行逐步优化。使用法向一致性目标与关键点对齐缓解ill-posed问题；引入基于高斯曲率和共形一致性的几何感知约束保持局部表面结构；辅以辅助正则化修正唇缝、眼睑不连续等细微伪影。
AI.result: 生成的网格具有语义化的边流和工业级拓扑。22位专业艺术家的用户研究中，95%将本文方法评为最佳，认为其结果接近工业级可用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的层次化优化与几何感知正则化框架有效解决了单图3D人脸重建中身份保留与拓扑质量的平衡问题，适用于数字人生产的实际场景。

title: Anticipating Innovation Using Large Language Models
summary: Forecasting innovation, intended as the emergence of new technological combinations, is a fundamental challenge for science and policy. We show that forthcoming combinations leave an early trace in the collective language of patents, with predictive signals detectable even decades in advance. We show that signal is not attributable to any single inventor, but emerges as a collective shift in how technologies are described across thousands of patents. To this end, we introduce TechToken, a transformer-based model that treats technologies, classified by International Patent Classification codes, as words in its vocabulary, learning the language of technologies by embedding these codes during fine-tuning. We define context similarity between code embeddings as a measure of linguistic convergence and show that it accurately predicts first technological combinations. TechToken also improves general representation quality, outperforming state-of-the-art models across different patent-related tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TechToken模型，利用专利分类代码的嵌入相似性预测新技术组合，证明技术融合在集体语言中早有预兆。
AI.motivation: 预测技术创新（即新技术组合的出现）是科学和政策的重大挑战，需要提前发现技术融合的信号。
AI.method: 将国际专利分类代码视为词汇，使用Transformer模型（TechToken）学习技术语言，通过代码嵌入的上下文相似度衡量语言收敛性，预测首次技术组合。
AI.result: TechToken能准确预测首次技术组合，且信号在数十年前即可检测到；该信号源于集体语言的转变而非单个发明者；模型在多项专利任务上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 技术创新的早期信号存在于专利集体语言中，TechToken通过捕捉这种信号可有效预测技术融合，并提升专利表示质量。

title: BenCSSmark: Making the Social Sciences Count in LLM Research
summary: This position paper argues that the under-representation of social science tasks in contemporary LLM benchmarks limits advances in both LLM evaluation and social scientific inquiry. Benchmarks -- standardized tools for assessing computational systems -- are pivotal in the development of artificial intelligence (AI), including large language models (LLMs). Benchmarks do more than measure progress -- they actively structure it, shaping reputations, research agendas, and commercial outcomes. Despite this central role, the social sciences are largely absent from mainstream evaluation frameworks, even though scholars in these fields generate dozens of rigorously annotated, context-sensitive datasets each year. Integrating this work into benchmark design could significantly improve the generalization and robustness of AI models. In turn, models trained on social scientific tasks would likely yield better performance on classic and contemporary tasks in disciplines as diverse as history, sociology, political science or economics. This is all the more pressing as these disciplines are quickly turning to LLMs for assistance. To address this gap, we introduce BenCSSmark, a benchmark composed of datasets annotated by computational social scientists. By integrating social scientific perspectives into benchmarking, BenCSSmark seeks to promote more robust, transparent, and socially relevant AI systems and to foster efficient collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前LLM基准测试缺乏社会科学任务，并提出BenCSSmark基准来弥补这一空白，以提升AI模型的鲁棒性和社会相关性。
AI.motivation: 当代LLM基准测试中社会科学任务的代表性不足，限制了LLM评估和社会科学研究的进步；社会科学领域虽每年产出大量高质量标注数据集，却未被纳入主流评估框架。
AI.method: 提出BenCSSmark基准，该基准由计算社会科学家标注的数据集构成，将社会科学视角整合到LLM基准设计中。
AI.result: BenCSSmark旨在促进更鲁棒、透明、具有社会相关性的AI系统，并推动高效协作。
AI.conclusion: 将社会科学任务纳入基准设计能显著提升AI模型的泛化性和鲁棒性，同时社会科学领域本身也能从更适配的LLM中受益。

title: InterMesh: Explicit Interaction-Aware End-to-End Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Humans constantly interact with their surroundings. Existing end-to-end multi-person human mesh recovery methods, typically based on the DETR framework, capture inter-human relationships through self-attention across all human queries. However, these approaches model interactions only implicitly and lack explicit reasoning about how humans interact with objects and with each other. In this paper, we propose InterMesh, a simple yet effective framework that explicitly incorporates human-environment interaction information into human mesh recovery pipeline. By leveraging a human-object interaction detector, InterMesh enriches query representations with structured interaction semantics, enabling more accurate pose and shape estimation. We design lightweight modules, Contextual Interaction Encoder and Interaction-Guided Refiner, to integrate these features into existing HMR architectures with minimal overhead. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on 3DPW, MuPoTS, CMU Panoptic, Hi4D, and CHI3D datasets, demonstrating remarkable improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Notably, InterMesh reduces MPJPE by 9.9% on CMU Panoptic and 8.2% on Hi4D, highlighting its effectiveness in scenarios with complex human-object and inter-human interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出InterMesh框架，通过显式融入人-物交互信息来提升多人人体网格恢复的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DETR的多人体网格恢复方法仅通过自注意力隐式建模交互，缺乏对人与物体、人与人之间交互的显式推理，导致在复杂交互场景下性能受限。
AI.method: 利用人-物交互检测器提取结构化交互语义，设计轻量级模块——上下文交互编码器和交互引导精炼器，将交互信息集成到现有HMR架构中。
AI.result: 在CMU Panoptic上MPJPE降低9.9%，在Hi4D上降低8.2%，在3DPW、MuPoTS、CHI3D等数据集上也实现显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模人-环境交互信息能有效提升多人体网格恢复的准确性，尤其在复杂交互场景中优势明显。

title: Efficient Geometry-Controlled High-Resolution Satellite Image Synthesis
comment: 2026 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS)
summary: High-resolution satellite images are often scarce and costly, especially for remote areas or infrequent events. This shortage hampers the development and testing of machine learning models for land-cover classification, change detection, and disaster monitoring. In this paper, we tackle the problem of geometry-controlled high-resolution satellite image synthesis by adding control over existing pre-trained diffusion models.
